e_basic_constr_invalid_der.en: Checks the correct DER encoding of the cA field in the BasicConstraints ext
e_basic_constr_invalid_der.zh: BasicConstraints 扩展中 cA 字段的 DER 编码必须正确
e_basic_constr_invalid_der.source: RFC 5280（X.509 PKI 证书/CRL 标准）

e_basic_constraints_not_critical.en: basicConstraints MUST appear as a critical extension
e_basic_constraints_not_critical.zh: basicConstraints 扩展必须标记为 critical（关键）
e_basic_constraints_not_critical.source: RFC 5280（X.509 PKI 证书/CRL 标准）

e_ca_subject_field_empty.en: The subject field of a CA certificate MUST have a non-empty distinguished name
e_ca_subject_field_empty.zh: CA 证书的 subject 字段必须包含非空的可识别名称 DN
e_ca_subject_field_empty.source: RFC 5280（X.509 PKI 证书/CRL 标准）

e_cert_contains_unique_identifier.en: CAs MUST NOT generate certificate with unique identifiers
e_cert_contains_unique_identifier.zh: CA 不得生成包含唯一标识符（uniqueIdentifier）字段的证书
e_cert_contains_unique_identifier.source: RFC 5280（X.509 PKI 证书/CRL 标准）

e_cert_ext_invalid_der.en: Checks that the 'critical' flag of extensions is not FALSE when present (as per DER encoding)
e_cert_ext_invalid_der.zh: 扩展的 critical 标志为 FALSE 时不应存在该标志（按 DER 编码要求）
e_cert_ext_invalid_der.source: RFC 5280（X.509 PKI 证书/CRL 标准）

e_cert_extensions_version_not_3.en: The extensions field MUST only appear in version 3 certificates
e_cert_extensions_version_not_3.zh: extensions 扩展字段只能出现在 v3 版本的证书中
e_cert_extensions_version_not_3.source: RFC 5280（X.509 PKI 证书/CRL 标准）

e_cert_sig_alg_not_match_tbs_sig_alg.en: Certificate signature field must match TBSCertificate signature field
e_cert_sig_alg_not_match_tbs_sig_alg.zh: 证书签名算法字段必须与 TBSCertificate 中的签名算法字段一致
e_cert_sig_alg_not_match_tbs_sig_alg.source: RFC 5280（X.509 PKI 证书/CRL 标准）

e_cert_unique_identifier_version_not_2_o.en: Unique identifiers MUST only appear if the X.509 version is 2 or 3
e_cert_unique_identifier_version_not_2_o.zh: 唯一标识符字段仅允许出现在 X.509 v2 或 v3 证书中
e_cert_unique_identifier_version_not_2_o.source: RFC 5280（X.509 PKI 证书/CRL 标准）

e_crl_empty_revoked_certificates.en: When there are no revoked certificates, the revoked certificates list MUST be absent
e_crl_empty_revoked_certificates.zh: 没有吊销证书时，revokedCertificates 列表必须省略
e_crl_empty_revoked_certificates.source: RFC 5280（X.509 PKI 证书/CRL 标准）

e_crl_has_authority_key_identifier.en: The CRL must include Authority Key Identifier extension.
e_crl_has_authority_key_identifier.zh: CRL 必须包含权威密钥标识符（AKI）扩展
e_crl_has_authority_key_identifier.source: RFC 5280（X.509 PKI 证书/CRL 标准）

e_crl_has_next_update.en: Conforming CRL issuers MUST include the nextUpdate field in all CRLs.
e_crl_has_next_update.zh: 合规的 CRL 签发者必须在所有 CRL 中包含 nextUpdate 字段
e_crl_has_next_update.source: RFC 5280（X.509 PKI 证书/CRL 标准）

e_crl_has_valid_reason_code.en: If a CRL entry has a reason code, it MUST be in RFC5280 section 5.3.1 and SHOULD be absent instead of using unspecified (0)
e_crl_has_valid_reason_code.zh: CRL 条目含吊销原因码时必须符合 RFC 5280 5.3.1 节；应省略而非使用未指定(0)
e_crl_has_valid_reason_code.source: RFC 5280（X.509 PKI 证书/CRL 标准）

e_crl_missing_crl_number.en: CRL issuers conforming to this profile MUST include this extension in all CRLs
e_crl_missing_crl_number.zh: 合规 CRL 必须包含 CRL Number（CRL 编号）扩展
e_crl_missing_crl_number.source: RFC 5280（X.509 PKI 证书/CRL 标准）

e_crl_revocation_time_after_this_update.en: All revocation times for revoked certificates must be on or before the thisUpdate field of the CRL.
e_crl_revocation_time_after_this_update.zh: 所有吊销时间必须不晚于 CRL 的 thisUpdate 字段
e_crl_revocation_time_after_this_update.source: RFC 5280（X.509 PKI 证书/CRL 标准）

e_crl_revoked_certificates_field_must_be.en: When the revokedCertificates field is empty, it MUST be absent from the DER-encoded ASN.1 data structure.
e_crl_revoked_certificates_field_must_be.zh: revokedCertificates 为空时，该字段必须从 DER 编码的 ASN.1 结构中省略
e_crl_revoked_certificates_field_must_be.source: RFC 5280（X.509 PKI 证书/CRL 标准）

e_crl_sigalgo_missing_null_params.en: Checks for mandatory NULL parameters in the SignatureAlgorithm
e_crl_sigalgo_missing_null_params.zh: CRL 签名算法（RSA）必须包含 NULL 参数
e_crl_sigalgo_missing_null_params.source: RFC 5280（X.509 PKI 证书/CRL 标准）

e_distribution_point_incomplete.en: A DistributionPoint from the CRLDistributionPoints extension MUST NOT consist of only the reasons field; either distributionPoint or CRLIssuer must be present
e_distribution_point_incomplete.zh: CRLDistributionPoints 扩展的 DistributionPoint 不得仅含 reasons 字段，distributionPoint 或 cRLIssuer 必须存在
e_distribution_point_incomplete.source: RFC 5280（X.509 PKI 证书/CRL 标准）

e_ecdsa_allowed_ku.en: Key usage values keyEncipherment or dataEncipherment MUST NOT be present in certificates with ECDSA public keys
e_ecdsa_allowed_ku.zh: ECDSA 公钥证书中不得存在 keyEncipherment 或 dataEncipherment 密钥用途

e_empty_sct_list.en: At least one SCT MUST be included in the SignedCertificateTimestampList extension
e_empty_sct_list.zh: SignedCertificateTimestampList 扩展中必须至少包含一个 SCT

e_ext_aia_marked_critical.en: Conforming CAs must mark the Authority Information Access extension as non-critical
e_ext_aia_marked_critical.zh: 权威信息访问（AIA）扩展必须标记为非 critical
e_ext_aia_marked_critical.source: RFC 5280（X.509 PKI 证书/CRL 标准）

e_ext_authority_key_identifier_critical.en: The authority key identifier extension must be non-critical
e_ext_authority_key_identifier_critical.zh: 权威密钥标识符（AKI）扩展必须为非 critical
e_ext_authority_key_identifier_critical.source: RFC 5280（X.509 PKI 证书/CRL 标准）

e_ext_authority_key_identifier_no_key_id.en: CAs must include keyIdentifer field of AKI in all non-self-issued certificates
e_ext_authority_key_identifier_no_key_id.zh: 非自签证书必须包含 AKI 的 keyIdentifier 字段
e_ext_authority_key_identifier_no_key_id.source: RFC 5280（X.509 PKI 证书/CRL 标准）

e_ext_cannot_be_empty_sequence.en: Extensions whose value is SEQUENCE SIZE (1..MAX) OF must have at least 1 element
e_ext_cannot_be_empty_sequence.zh: 值为 SEQUENCE SIZE (1..MAX) OF 的扩展必须至少包含 1 个元素
e_ext_cannot_be_empty_sequence.source: RFC 5280（X.509 PKI 证书/CRL 标准）

e_ext_cert_policy_disallowed_any_policy_.en: When qualifiers are used with the special policy anyPolicy, they must be limited to qualifiers identified in this section: (4.2.1.4)
e_ext_cert_policy_disallowed_any_policy_.zh: anyPolicy 策略使用 qualifier 时须限于规范 4.2.1.4 节定义的限定符
e_ext_cert_policy_disallowed_any_policy_.source: RFC 5280（X.509 PKI 证书/CRL 标准）

e_ext_cert_policy_duplicate.en: A certificate policy OID must not appear more than once in the extension
e_ext_cert_policy_duplicate.zh: 证书策略 OID 不得在扩展中出现多次
e_ext_cert_policy_duplicate.source: RFC 5280（X.509 PKI 证书/CRL 标准）

e_ext_cert_policy_explicit_text_ia5_stri.en: Compliant certificates must not encode explicitTest as an IA5String
e_ext_cert_policy_explicit_text_ia5_stri.zh: 合规证书不得将 explicitText 编码为 IA5String
e_ext_cert_policy_explicit_text_ia5_stri.source: RFC 5280（X.509 PKI 证书/CRL 标准）

e_ext_cert_policy_explicit_text_too_long.en: Explicit text has a maximum size of 200 characters
e_ext_cert_policy_explicit_text_too_long.zh: 策略显式文本（explicitText）最大长度为 200 字符
e_ext_cert_policy_explicit_text_too_long.source: RFC 5280（X.509 PKI 证书/CRL 标准）

e_ext_duplicate_extension.en: A certificate MUST NOT include more than one instance of a particular extension
e_ext_duplicate_extension.zh: 证书不得包含同一扩展的多个实例
e_ext_duplicate_extension.source: RFC 5280（X.509 PKI 证书/CRL 标准）

e_ext_freshest_crl_marked_critical.en: Freshest CRL MUST be marked as non-critical by conforming CAs
e_ext_freshest_crl_marked_critical.zh: Freshest CRL 扩展必须标记为非 critical
e_ext_freshest_crl_marked_critical.source: RFC 5280（X.509 PKI 证书/CRL 标准）

e_ext_ian_dns_not_ia5_string.zh: IAN 扩展中的 DNSName 必须是 IA5 字符串
e_ext_ian_dns_not_ia5_string.source: RFC 5280（X.509 PKI 证书/CRL 标准）

e_ext_ian_empty_name.en: General name fields must not be empty in IAN
e_ext_ian_empty_name.zh: IAN 中的通用名称字段不得为空
e_ext_ian_empty_name.source: RFC 5280（X.509 PKI 证书/CRL 标准）

e_ext_ian_no_entries.en: If present, the IAN extension must contain at least one entry
e_ext_ian_no_entries.zh: IAN 扩展若存在则必须至少包含一个条目
e_ext_ian_no_entries.source: RFC 5280（X.509 PKI 证书/CRL 标准）

e_ext_ian_rfc822_format_invalid.en: Email must not be surrounded with `<>`, and there MUST NOT be trailing comments in `()`
e_ext_ian_rfc822_format_invalid.zh: IAN 中的邮箱地址不得用<>包裹，也不得带有()尾随注释
e_ext_ian_rfc822_format_invalid.source: RFC 5280（X.509 PKI 证书/CRL 标准）

e_ext_ian_space_dns_name.zh: IAN 中不得使用空格作为 dNSName
e_ext_ian_space_dns_name.source: RFC 5280（X.509 PKI 证书/CRL 标准）

e_ext_ian_uri_format_invalid.en: URIs in the subjectAltName extension MUST have a scheme and scheme specific part
e_ext_ian_uri_format_invalid.zh: subjectAltName 扩展中的 URI 必须包含 scheme 和具体部分
e_ext_ian_uri_format_invalid.source: RFC 5280（X.509 PKI 证书/CRL 标准）

e_ext_ian_uri_host_not_fqdn_or_ip.en: URIs that include an authority ([RFC3986], Section 3.2) MUST include a fully qualified domain name or IP address as the host
e_ext_ian_uri_host_not_fqdn_or_ip.zh: 含 authority 的 URI 主机必须是完全限定域名或 IP 地址
e_ext_ian_uri_host_not_fqdn_or_ip.source: RFC 5280（X.509 PKI 证书/CRL 标准）

e_ext_ian_uri_not_ia5.en: When issuer alternative name contains a URI, the name MUST be an IA5 string
e_ext_ian_uri_not_ia5.zh: 签发者备用名称中的 URI 必须是 IA5 字符串
e_ext_ian_uri_not_ia5.source: RFC 5280（X.509 PKI 证书/CRL 标准）

e_ext_ian_uri_relative.en: When issuerAltName extension is present and the URI is used, the name MUST NOT be a relative URI
e_ext_ian_uri_relative.zh: issuerAltName 扩展中的 URI 不得是相对 URI
e_ext_ian_uri_relative.source: RFC 5280（X.509 PKI 证书/CRL 标准）

e_ext_key_usage_cert_sign_without_ca.en: if the keyCertSign bit is asserted, then the cA bit in the basic constraints extension MUST also be asserted
e_ext_key_usage_cert_sign_without_ca.zh: 若设置 keyCertSign 位，则 basicConstraints 的 cA 位也必须设置
e_ext_key_usage_cert_sign_without_ca.source: RFC 5280（X.509 PKI 证书/CRL 标准）

e_ext_key_usage_without_bits.en: When the keyUsage extension is included, at least one bit MUST be set to 1
e_ext_key_usage_without_bits.zh: 包含 keyUsage 扩展时至少要将一个位设为 1
e_ext_key_usage_without_bits.source: RFC 5280（X.509 PKI 证书/CRL 标准）

e_ext_name_constraints_not_critical.en: If it is included, conforming CAs MUST mark the name constraints extension as critical
e_ext_name_constraints_not_critical.zh: nameConstraints 扩展必须标记为 critical
e_ext_name_constraints_not_critical.source: RFC 5280（X.509 PKI 证书/CRL 标准）

e_ext_name_constraints_not_in_ca.en: The name constraints extension MUST only be used in CA certificates
e_ext_name_constraints_not_in_ca.zh: nameConstraints 扩展只能用于 CA 证书
e_ext_name_constraints_not_in_ca.source: RFC 5280（X.509 PKI 证书/CRL 标准）

e_ext_policy_constraints_empty.en: Conforming CAs MUST NOT issue certificates where policy constraints is an empty sequence. That is, either the inhibitPolicyMapping field or the requireExplicityPolicy field MUST be present
e_ext_policy_constraints_empty.zh: policyConstraints 不得为空序列，inhibitPolicyMapping 或 requireExplicitPolicy 至少一个必须存在
e_ext_policy_constraints_empty.source: RFC 5280（X.509 PKI 证书/CRL 标准）

e_ext_policy_constraints_not_critical.en: Conforming CAs MUST mark the policy constraints extension as critical
e_ext_policy_constraints_not_critical.zh: policyConstraints 扩展必须标记为 critical
e_ext_policy_constraints_not_critical.source: RFC 5280（X.509 PKI 证书/CRL 标准）

e_ext_policy_map_any_policy.en: Policies must not be mapped to or from the anyPolicy value
e_ext_policy_map_any_policy.zh: 策略映射不得映射到或来自 anyPolicy 值
e_ext_policy_map_any_policy.source: RFC 5280（X.509 PKI 证书/CRL 标准）

e_ext_san_dns_name_too_long.en: DNSName must be less than or equal to 253 bytes
e_ext_san_dns_name_too_long.zh: DNSName 不得超过 253 字节
e_ext_san_dns_name_too_long.source: RFC 5280（X.509 PKI 证书/CRL 标准）

e_ext_san_dns_not_ia5_string.zh: SAN 中的 dNSName 必须是 IA5 字符串
e_ext_san_dns_not_ia5_string.source: RFC 5280（X.509 PKI 证书/CRL 标准）

e_ext_san_empty_name.en: General name fields MUST NOT be empty in subjectAlternateNames
e_ext_san_empty_name.zh: subjectAltName 中的通用名称字段不得为空
e_ext_san_empty_name.source: RFC 5280（X.509 PKI 证书/CRL 标准）

e_ext_san_no_entries.en: If present, the SAN extension MUST contain at least one entry
e_ext_san_no_entries.zh: SAN 扩展若存在则必须至少包含一个条目
e_ext_san_no_entries.source: RFC 5280（X.509 PKI 证书/CRL 标准）

e_ext_san_not_critical_without_subject.en: If there is an empty subject field, then the SAN extension MUST be critical
e_ext_san_not_critical_without_subject.zh: subject 字段为空时，SAN 扩展必须标记为 critical
e_ext_san_not_critical_without_subject.source: RFC 5280（X.509 PKI 证书/CRL 标准）

e_ext_san_rfc822_format_invalid.en: Email MUST NOT be surrounded with `<>`, and there must be no trailing comments in `()`
e_ext_san_rfc822_format_invalid.zh: SAN 中的邮箱地址不得用<>包裹，也不得带有()尾随注释
e_ext_san_rfc822_format_invalid.source: RFC 5280（X.509 PKI 证书/CRL 标准）

e_ext_san_space_dns_name.en: The dNSName ` ` MUST NOT be used
e_ext_san_space_dns_name.zh: SAN 中不得使用空格作为 dNSName
e_ext_san_space_dns_name.source: RFC 5280（X.509 PKI 证书/CRL 标准）

e_ext_san_uri_format_invalid.en: URIs in SAN extension must have a scheme and scheme specific part
e_ext_san_uri_format_invalid.zh: SAN 扩展中的 URI 必须包含 scheme 和具体部分
e_ext_san_uri_format_invalid.source: RFC 5280（X.509 PKI 证书/CRL 标准）

e_ext_san_uri_host_not_fqdn_or_ip.en: URIs that include an authority ([RFC3986], Section 3.2) MUST include a fully qualified domain name or IP address as the host
e_ext_san_uri_host_not_fqdn_or_ip.zh: 含 authority 的 URI 主机必须是完全限定域名或 IP 地址
e_ext_san_uri_host_not_fqdn_or_ip.source: RFC 5280（X.509 PKI 证书/CRL 标准）

e_ext_san_uri_not_ia5.en: When subjectAlternateName contains a URI, the name MUST be an IA5 string
e_ext_san_uri_not_ia5.zh: subjectAltName 中的 URI 必须是 IA5 字符串
e_ext_san_uri_not_ia5.source: RFC 5280（X.509 PKI 证书/CRL 标准）

e_ext_san_uri_relative.en: When the subjectAlternateName extension is present and a URI is used, the name MUST NOT be a relative URI
e_ext_san_uri_relative.zh: subjectAltName 扩展中的 URI 不得是相对 URI
e_ext_san_uri_relative.source: RFC 5280（X.509 PKI 证书/CRL 标准）

e_ext_subject_directory_attr_critical.en: Conforming CAs MUST mark the Subject Directory Attributes extension as not critical
e_ext_subject_directory_attr_critical.zh: Subject Directory Attributes 扩展必须标记为非 critical
e_ext_subject_directory_attr_critical.source: RFC 5280（X.509 PKI 证书/CRL 标准）

e_ext_subject_key_identifier_critical.en: The subject key identifier extension MUST be non-critical
e_ext_subject_key_identifier_critical.zh: 主体密钥标识符（SKI）扩展必须为非 critical
e_ext_subject_key_identifier_critical.source: RFC 5280（X.509 PKI 证书/CRL 标准）

e_ext_subject_key_identifier_missing_ca.en: CAs MUST include a Subject Key Identifier in all CA certificates
e_ext_subject_key_identifier_missing_ca.zh: CA 证书必须包含主体密钥标识符（SKI）
e_ext_subject_key_identifier_missing_ca.source: RFC 5280（X.509 PKI 证书/CRL 标准）

e_generalized_time_does_not_include_seco.en: Generalized time values MUST include seconds
e_generalized_time_does_not_include_seco.zh: GeneralizedTime 时间值必须包含秒
e_generalized_time_does_not_include_seco.source: RFC 5280（X.509 PKI 证书/CRL 标准）

e_generalized_time_includes_fraction_sec.en: Generalized time values MUST NOT include fractional seconds
e_generalized_time_includes_fraction_sec.zh: GeneralizedTime 时间值不得包含小数秒
e_generalized_time_includes_fraction_sec.source: RFC 5280（X.509 PKI 证书/CRL 标准）

e_generalized_time_not_in_zulu.en: Generalized time values MUST be expressed in Greenwich Mean Time (Zulu)
e_generalized_time_not_in_zulu.zh: GeneralizedTime 时间值必须以格林尼治标准时间（Zulu）表示
e_generalized_time_not_in_zulu.source: RFC 5280（X.509 PKI 证书/CRL 标准）

e_incorrect_ku_encoding.en: RFC 5280 Section 4.2.1.3 describes the value of a KeyUsage to be a DER encoded BitString, which itself defines that all trailing 0 bits be counted as being "unused".
e_incorrect_ku_encoding.zh: KeyUsage 应为 DER 编码的 BitString，尾部多余的 0 位应计为 unused
e_incorrect_ku_encoding.source: RFC 5280（X.509 PKI 证书/CRL 标准）

e_inhibit_any_policy_not_critical.en: CAs MUST mark the inhibitAnyPolicy extension as critical
e_inhibit_any_policy_not_critical.zh: inhibitAnyPolicy 扩展必须标记为 critical
e_inhibit_any_policy_not_critical.source: RFC 5280（X.509 PKI 证书/CRL 标准）

e_international_dns_name_not_nfc.en: Internationalized DNSNames must be normalized by Unicode normalization form C
e_international_dns_name_not_nfc.zh: 国际化 DNSName 必须使用 Unicode 规范化形式 C（NFC）

e_international_dns_name_not_unicode.en: Internationalized DNSNames punycode not valid Unicode
e_international_dns_name_not_unicode.zh: 国际化 DNSName 的 punycode 编码必须是有效的 Unicode
e_international_dns_name_not_unicode.source: RFC 5280（X.509 PKI 证书/CRL 标准）

e_issuer_dn_country_not_printable_string.en: X520 Distinguished Name Country MUST BE encoded as PrintableString
e_issuer_dn_country_not_printable_string.zh: X520 可识别名称中的国家（C）必须编码为 PrintableString
e_issuer_dn_country_not_printable_string.source: RFC 5280（X.509 PKI 证书/CRL 标准）

e_issuer_field_empty.en: Certificate issuer field MUST NOT be empty and must have a non-empty distinguished name
e_issuer_field_empty.zh: 证书 issuer 字段不得为空，且必须包含非空的可识别名称
e_issuer_field_empty.source: RFC 5280（X.509 PKI 证书/CRL 标准）

e_key_usage_and_extended_key_usage_incon.en: The certificate MUST only be used for a purpose consistent with both key usage extension and extended key usage extension.
e_key_usage_and_extended_key_usage_incon.zh: 证书用途必须同时符合 keyUsage 与 extendedKeyUsage 扩展
e_key_usage_and_extended_key_usage_incon.source: RFC 5280（X.509 PKI 证书/CRL 标准）

e_key_usage_incorrect_length.en: The key usage is a bit string with exactly nine possible flags
e_key_usage_incorrect_length.zh: keyUsage 是恰好包含 9 个标志位的位串
e_key_usage_incorrect_length.source: RFC 5280（X.509 PKI 证书/CRL 标准）

e_name_constraint_empty.en: Conforming CAs MUST NOT issue certificates where name constraints is an empty sequence. That is, either the permittedSubtree or excludedSubtree fields must be present
e_name_constraint_empty.zh: nameConstraints 不得为空序列，permittedSubtrees 或 excludedSubtrees 至少一个必须存在
e_name_constraint_empty.source: RFC 5280（X.509 PKI 证书/CRL 标准）

e_name_constraint_maximum_not_absent.en: Within the name constraints name form, the maximum field is not used and therefore MUST be absent
e_name_constraint_maximum_not_absent.zh: 名称约束中的 maximum 字段不使用，必须省略
e_name_constraint_maximum_not_absent.source: RFC 5280（X.509 PKI 证书/CRL 标准）

e_name_constraint_minimum_non_zero.en: Within the name constraints name forms, the minimum field is not used and therefore MUST be zero
e_name_constraint_minimum_non_zero.zh: 名称约束中的 minimum 字段不使用，必须为零
e_name_constraint_minimum_non_zero.source: RFC 5280（X.509 PKI 证书/CRL 标准）

e_name_constraint_not_fqdn.en: For URIs, the constraint MUST be specified as a fully qualified domain name [...] When the constraint begins with a period, it MAY be expanded with one or more labels.
e_name_constraint_not_fqdn.zh: URI 名称约束必须指定为完全限定域名；以句点开头时可扩展一个或多个标签
e_name_constraint_not_fqdn.source: RFC 5280（X.509 PKI 证书/CRL 标准）

e_path_len_constraint_improperly_include.en: CAs MUST NOT include the pathLenConstraint field unless the CA boolean is asserted and the keyCertSign bit is set
e_path_len_constraint_improperly_include.zh: 仅当 cA 位与 keyCertSign 位均设置时才允许包含 pathLenConstraint 字段
e_path_len_constraint_improperly_include.source: RFC 5280（X.509 PKI 证书/CRL 标准）

e_path_len_constraint_zero_or_less.en: Where it appears, the pathLenConstraint field MUST be greater than or equal to zero
e_path_len_constraint_zero_or_less.zh: pathLenConstraint 字段必须大于或等于零
e_path_len_constraint_zero_or_less.source: RFC 5280（X.509 PKI 证书/CRL 标准）

e_precert_with_sct_list.en: SCTs must be embedded in the final certificate, not in a precertificate
e_precert_with_sct_list.zh: SCT 必须嵌入最终证书，而非预证书（precertificate）

e_rfc_dnsname_empty_label.en: DNSNames should not have an empty label.
e_rfc_dnsname_empty_label.source: RFC 5280（X.509 PKI 证书/CRL 标准）

e_rfc_dnsname_hyphen_in_sld.en: DNSName should not have a hyphen beginning or ending the SLD
e_rfc_dnsname_hyphen_in_sld.zh: DNSName 的二级域名（SLD）不得以连字符开头或结尾
e_rfc_dnsname_hyphen_in_sld.source: RFC 5280（X.509 PKI 证书/CRL 标准）

e_rfc_dnsname_label_too_long.en: DNSName labels MUST be less than or equal to 63 characters
e_rfc_dnsname_label_too_long.zh: DNSName 标签长度必须小于等于 63 字符
e_rfc_dnsname_label_too_long.source: RFC 5280（X.509 PKI 证书/CRL 标准）

e_rfc_dnsname_underscore_in_sld.en: DNSName MUST NOT contain underscore characters
e_rfc_dnsname_underscore_in_sld.zh: DNSName 不得包含下划线字符
e_rfc_dnsname_underscore_in_sld.source: RFC 5280（X.509 PKI 证书/CRL 标准）

e_rsa_allowed_ku_ca.en: Key usage values digitalSignature, nonRepudiation, keyEncipherment, dataEncipherment, keyCertSign, and cRLSign may only be present in a CA certificate with an RSA key
e_rsa_allowed_ku_ca.zh: RSA 密钥的 CA 证书只能包含 digitalSignature、nonRepudiation、keyEncipherment、dataEncipherment、keyCertSign、cRLSign 等密钥用途
e_rsa_allowed_ku_ca.source: RFC 3279（证书算法与 ASN.1 结构）

e_rsa_allowed_ku_ee.en: Key usage values digitalSignature, nonRepudiation, keyEncipherment, and dataEncipherment may only be present in an end entity certificate with an RSA key
e_rsa_allowed_ku_ee.zh: RSA 密钥的终端实体证书只能包含 digitalSignature、nonRepudiation、keyEncipherment、dataEncipherment 密钥用途
e_rsa_allowed_ku_ee.source: RFC 3279（证书算法与 ASN.1 结构）

e_rsa_allowed_ku_no_encipherment_ca.en: If Key usage value keyCertSign or cRLSign is present in a CA certificate both keyEncipherment and dataEncipherment SHOULD NOT be present
e_rsa_allowed_ku_no_encipherment_ca.zh: CA 证书含 keyCertSign 或 cRLSign 时，不应同时含 keyEncipherment 和 dataEncipherment
e_rsa_allowed_ku_no_encipherment_ca.source: RFC 3279（证书算法与 ASN.1 结构）

e_serial_number_longer_than_20_octets.en: Certificates must not have a DER encoded serial number longer than 20 octets
e_serial_number_longer_than_20_octets.zh: 证书序列号的 DER 编码不得超过 20 字节
e_serial_number_longer_than_20_octets.source: RFC 5280（X.509 PKI 证书/CRL 标准）

e_serial_number_not_positive.en: Certificates must have a positive serial number
e_serial_number_not_positive.zh: 证书序列号必须为正整数
e_serial_number_not_positive.source: RFC 5280（X.509 PKI 证书/CRL 标准）

e_spki_rsa_encryption_parameter_not_null.en: RSA: Encoded public key algorithm identifier MUST have NULL parameters
e_spki_rsa_encryption_parameter_not_null.zh: RSA 公钥算法标识符必须带有 NULL 参数
e_spki_rsa_encryption_parameter_not_null.source: RFC 5280（X.509 PKI 证书/CRL 标准）

e_subj_email_not_in_san.en: Certificates with email addresses MUST include them in the SAN extension
e_subj_email_not_in_san.zh: 含邮箱地址的证书必须将其放入 SAN 扩展
e_subj_email_not_in_san.source: RFC 5280（X.509 PKI 证书/CRL 标准）

e_subject_common_name_max_length.en: The commonName field of the subject MUST be less than 65 characters
e_subject_common_name_max_length.zh: subject 的 commonName 字段必须小于 65 字符
e_subject_common_name_max_length.source: RFC 5280（X.509 PKI 证书/CRL 标准）

e_subject_dn_country_not_printable_strin.en: X520 Distinguished Name Country MUST be encoded as PrintableString
e_subject_dn_country_not_printable_strin.zh: X520 可识别名称中的国家（C）必须编码为 PrintableString
e_subject_dn_country_not_printable_strin.source: RFC 5280（X.509 PKI 证书/CRL 标准）

e_subject_dn_not_printable_characters.en: X520 Subject fields MUST only contain printable control characters
e_subject_dn_not_printable_characters.zh: X520 主体字段只能包含可打印的控制字符
e_subject_dn_not_printable_characters.source: RFC 5280（X.509 PKI 证书/CRL 标准）

e_subject_dn_serial_number_max_length.en: The 'Serial Number' field of the subject MUST be less than 65 characters
e_subject_dn_serial_number_max_length.zh: subject 的 SerialNumber 字段必须小于 65 字符
e_subject_dn_serial_number_max_length.source: RFC 5280（X.509 PKI 证书/CRL 标准）

e_subject_dn_serial_number_not_printable.en: X520 Distinguished Name SerialNumber MUST be encoded as PrintableString
e_subject_dn_serial_number_not_printable.zh: X520 可识别名称中的 SerialNumber 必须编码为 PrintableString
e_subject_dn_serial_number_not_printable.source: RFC 5280（X.509 PKI 证书/CRL 标准）

e_subject_email_max_length.en: The 'Email' field of the subject MUST be less than 256 characters
e_subject_email_max_length.zh: subject 的 Email 字段必须小于 256 字符
e_subject_email_max_length.source: RFC 5280（X.509 PKI 证书/CRL 标准）

e_subject_empty_without_san.en: CAs MUST support subject alternative name if the subject field is an empty sequence
e_subject_empty_without_san.zh: subject 字段为空序列时，必须支持主体备用名称（SAN）
e_subject_empty_without_san.source: RFC 5280（X.509 PKI 证书/CRL 标准）

e_subject_given_name_max_length.en: The 'GivenName' field of the subject MUST be less than 32769 characters
e_subject_given_name_max_length.zh: subject 的 GivenName 字段必须小于 32769 字符
e_subject_given_name_max_length.source: RFC 5280（X.509 PKI 证书/CRL 标准）

e_subject_info_access_marked_critical.en: Conforming CAs MUST mark the Subject Info Access extension as non-critical
e_subject_info_access_marked_critical.zh: Subject Info Access 扩展必须标记为非 critical
e_subject_info_access_marked_critical.source: RFC 5280（X.509 PKI 证书/CRL 标准）

e_subject_locality_name_max_length.en: The 'Locality Name' field of the subject MUST be less than 129 characters
e_subject_locality_name_max_length.zh: subject 的 Locality Name（L）字段必须小于 129 字符
e_subject_locality_name_max_length.source: RFC 5280（X.509 PKI 证书/CRL 标准）

e_subject_not_dn.en: When not empty, the subject field MUST be a distinguished name
e_subject_not_dn.zh: subject 字段非空时必须为可识别名称（DN）
e_subject_not_dn.source: RFC 5280（X.509 PKI 证书/CRL 标准）

e_subject_organization_name_max_length.en: The 'Organization Name' field of the subject MUST be less than 65 characters
e_subject_organization_name_max_length.zh: subject 的 Organization Name（O）字段必须小于 65 字符
e_subject_organization_name_max_length.source: RFC 5280（X.509 PKI 证书/CRL 标准）

e_subject_organizational_unit_name_max_l.en: The 'Organizational Unit Name' field of the subject MUST be less than 65 characters
e_subject_organizational_unit_name_max_l.zh: subject 的 Organizational Unit Name（OU）字段必须小于 65 字符
e_subject_organizational_unit_name_max_l.source: RFC 5280（X.509 PKI 证书/CRL 标准）

e_subject_postal_code_max_length.en: The 'PostalCode' field of the subject MUST be less than 17 characters
e_subject_postal_code_max_length.zh: subject 的 PostalCode 字段必须小于 17 字符
e_subject_postal_code_max_length.source: RFC 5280（X.509 PKI 证书/CRL 标准）

e_subject_printable_string_badalpha.en: PrintableString type's alphabet only includes a-z, A-Z, 0-9, and 11 special characters
e_subject_printable_string_badalpha.zh: PrintableString 字母表仅包含 a-z、A-Z、0-9 和 11 个特殊字符
e_subject_printable_string_badalpha.source: RFC 5280（X.509 PKI 证书/CRL 标准）

e_subject_state_name_max_length.en: The 'State Name' field of the subject MUST be less than 129 characters
e_subject_state_name_max_length.zh: subject 的 State Name（ST）字段必须小于 129 字符
e_subject_state_name_max_length.source: RFC 5280（X.509 PKI 证书/CRL 标准）

e_subject_street_address_max_length.en: The 'StreetAddress' field of the subject MUST be less than 129 characters
e_subject_street_address_max_length.zh: subject 的 StreetAddress 字段必须小于 129 字符
e_subject_street_address_max_length.source: RFC 5280（X.509 PKI 证书/CRL 标准）

e_subject_surname_max_length.en: The 'Surname' field of the subject MUST be less than 32769 characters
e_subject_surname_max_length.zh: subject 的 Surname 字段必须小于 32769 字符
e_subject_surname_max_length.source: RFC 5280（X.509 PKI 证书/CRL 标准）

e_superfluous_ku_encoding.en: RFC 5280 Section 4.2.1.3 describes the value of a KeyUsage to be a DER encoded BitString, which itself must not have unnecessary trailing 00 bytes.
e_superfluous_ku_encoding.zh: KeyUsage 的 DER 编码 BitString 不得有冗余的尾随 00 字节
e_superfluous_ku_encoding.source: RFC 5280（X.509 PKI 证书/CRL 标准）

e_tbs_signature_rsa_encryption_parameter.en: RSA: Encoded signature algorithm identifier MUST have NULL parameters
e_tbs_signature_rsa_encryption_parameter.zh: RSA 签名算法标识符必须带有 NULL 参数
e_tbs_signature_rsa_encryption_parameter.source: RFC 5280（X.509 PKI 证书/CRL 标准）

e_this_update_not_after_produced_at.en: The value of thisUpdate MUST be prior to the time at which the response is produced, i.e., the value of producedAt
e_this_update_not_after_produced_at.zh: OCSP 响应的 thisUpdate 必须早于 producedAt（响应生成时间）
e_this_update_not_after_produced_at.source: RFC 6960（OCSP 在线证书状态协议）

e_utc_time_does_not_include_seconds.zh: UTCTime 时间值必须包含秒
e_utc_time_does_not_include_seconds.source: RFC 5280（X.509 PKI 证书/CRL 标准）

e_utc_time_not_in_zulu.en: UTCTime values MUST be expressed in Greenwich Mean Time (Zulu)
e_utc_time_not_in_zulu.zh: UTCTime 时间值必须以格林尼治标准时间（Zulu）表示
e_utc_time_not_in_zulu.source: RFC 5280（X.509 PKI 证书/CRL 标准）

e_wrong_time_format_pre2050.en: Certificates valid through the year 2049 MUST be encoded in UTC time
e_wrong_time_format_pre2050.zh: 有效期至 2049 年的证书时间必须编码为 UTC 时间
e_wrong_time_format_pre2050.source: RFC 5280（X.509 PKI 证书/CRL 标准）

n_ecdsa_ee_invalid_ku.en: ECDSA end-entity certificates MAY have key usages: digitalSignature, nonRepudiation and keyAgreement
n_ecdsa_ee_invalid_ku.zh: ECDSA 终端实体证书允许的密钥用途：digitalSignature、nonRepudiation 和 keyAgreement

w_distribution_point_missing_ldap_or_uri.en: When present in the CRLDistributionPoints extension, DistributionPointName SHOULD include at least one LDAP or HTTP URI
w_distribution_point_missing_ldap_or_uri.zh: CRLDistributionPoints 扩展中的 DistributionPointName 应至少包含一个 LDAP 或 HTTP URI
w_distribution_point_missing_ldap_or_uri.source: RFC 5280（X.509 PKI 证书/CRL 标准）

w_eku_critical_improperly.en: Conforming CAs SHOULD NOT mark extended key usage extension as critical if the anyExtendedKeyUsage KeyPurposedID is present
w_eku_critical_improperly.zh: 含 anyExtendedKeyUsage 时，不应将 extendedKeyUsage 扩展标记为 critical
w_eku_critical_improperly.source: RFC 5280（X.509 PKI 证书/CRL 标准）

w_ext_aia_access_location_missing.en: When the id-ad-caIssuers accessMethod is used, at least one instance SHOULD specify an accessLocation that is an HTTP or LDAP URI
w_ext_aia_access_location_missing.zh: 使用 id-ad-caIssuers 访问方法时，至少一个 accessLocation 应为 HTTP 或 LDAP URI
w_ext_aia_access_location_missing.source: RFC 5280（X.509 PKI 证书/CRL 标准）

w_ext_cert_policy_contains_noticeref.en: Compliant certificates SHOULD NOT use the noticeRef option
w_ext_cert_policy_contains_noticeref.zh: 合规证书不应使用 noticeRef 选项
w_ext_cert_policy_contains_noticeref.source: RFC 5280（X.509 PKI 证书/CRL 标准）

w_ext_cert_policy_explicit_text_includes.en: Explicit text should not include any control characters
w_ext_cert_policy_explicit_text_includes.zh: 策略显式文本不应包含任何控制字符
w_ext_cert_policy_explicit_text_includes.source: RFC 5280（X.509 PKI 证书/CRL 标准）

w_ext_cert_policy_explicit_text_not_nfc.en: When utf8string or bmpstring encoding is used for explicitText field in certificate policy, it SHOULD be normalized by NFC format
w_ext_cert_policy_explicit_text_not_nfc.zh: explicitText 使用 utf8string 或 bmpstring 编码时应按 NFC 规范化
w_ext_cert_policy_explicit_text_not_nfc.source: RFC 5280（X.509 PKI 证书/CRL 标准）

w_ext_cert_policy_explicit_text_not_utf8.en: Compliant certificates should use the utf8string encoding for explicitText
w_ext_cert_policy_explicit_text_not_utf8.zh: 合规证书应使用 utf8string 编码 explicitText
w_ext_cert_policy_explicit_text_not_utf8.source: RFC 5280（X.509 PKI 证书/CRL 标准）

w_ext_crl_distribution_marked_critical.en: If included, the CRL Distribution Points extension SHOULD NOT be marked critical
w_ext_crl_distribution_marked_critical.zh: CRL Distribution Points 扩展不应标记为 critical
w_ext_crl_distribution_marked_critical.source: RFC 5280（X.509 PKI 证书/CRL 标准）

w_ext_ian_critical.en: Issuer alternate name should be marked as non-critical
w_ext_ian_critical.zh: 签发者备用名称（IAN）扩展应标记为非 critical
w_ext_ian_critical.source: RFC 5280（X.509 PKI 证书/CRL 标准）

w_ext_key_usage_not_critical.en: The keyUsage extension SHOULD be critical
w_ext_key_usage_not_critical.zh: keyUsage 扩展应标记为 critical
w_ext_key_usage_not_critical.source: RFC 5280（X.509 PKI 证书/CRL 标准）

w_ext_policy_map_not_critical.en: Policy mappings should be marked as critical
w_ext_policy_map_not_critical.zh: policyMappings 扩展应标记为 critical
w_ext_policy_map_not_critical.source: RFC 5280（X.509 PKI 证书/CRL 标准）

w_ext_policy_map_not_in_cert_policy.en: Each issuerDomainPolicy named in the policy mappings extension should also be asserted in a certificate policies extension
w_ext_policy_map_not_in_cert_policy.zh: policyMappings 中的每个 issuerDomainPolicy 也应出现在 certificatePolicies 扩展中
w_ext_policy_map_not_in_cert_policy.source: RFC 5280（X.509 PKI 证书/CRL 标准）

w_ext_subject_key_identifier_missing_sub.en: Sub certificates SHOULD include Subject Key Identifier in end entity certs
w_ext_subject_key_identifier_missing_sub.zh: 终端实体证书应包含主体密钥标识符（SKI）
w_ext_subject_key_identifier_missing_sub.source: RFC 5280（X.509 PKI 证书/CRL 标准）

w_name_constraint_on_edi_party_name.en: The name constraints extension SHOULD NOT impose constraints on the ediPartyName name form
w_name_constraint_on_edi_party_name.zh: nameConstraints 不应约束 ediPartyName 名称形式
w_name_constraint_on_edi_party_name.source: RFC 5280（X.509 PKI 证书/CRL 标准）

w_name_constraint_on_registered_id.en: The name constraints extension SHOULD NOT impose constraints on the registeredID name form
w_name_constraint_on_registered_id.zh: nameConstraints 不应约束 registeredID 名称形式
w_name_constraint_on_registered_id.source: RFC 5280（X.509 PKI 证书/CRL 标准）

w_name_constraint_on_x400.en: The name constraints extension SHOULD NOT impose constraints on the x400Address name form
w_name_constraint_on_x400.zh: nameConstraints 不应约束 x400Address 名称形式
w_name_constraint_on_x400.source: RFC 5280（X.509 PKI 证书/CRL 标准）

w_rfc_dnsname_underscore_in_trd.en: DNSName MUST NOT contain underscore characters
w_rfc_dnsname_underscore_in_trd.zh: DNSName 不应包含下划线字符
w_rfc_dnsname_underscore_in_trd.source: RFC 5280（X.509 PKI 证书/CRL 标准）

w_subject_given_name_recommended_max_len.en: X.411 (1988) describes ub-common-name-length to be 64 bytes long. As systems may have
w_subject_given_name_recommended_max_len.zh: subject 的 GivenName 字段建议不超过 64 字节（X.411）
w_subject_given_name_recommended_max_len.source: RFC 5280（X.509 PKI 证书/CRL 标准）

w_subject_surname_recommended_max_length.en: X.411 (1988) describes ub-common-name-length to be 64 bytes long. As systems may have
w_subject_surname_recommended_max_length.zh: subject 的 Surname 字段建议不超过 64 字节（X.411）
w_subject_surname_recommended_max_length.source: RFC 5280（X.509 PKI 证书/CRL 标准）

e_aia_ca_issuers_must_have_http_only.en: The id-ad-caIssuers accessMethod must contain an HTTP URL of the Issuing CA’s certificate. Other schemes are not allowed.
e_aia_ca_issuers_must_have_http_only.zh: AIA 的 id-ad-caIssuers 访问方法必须包含签发 CA 证书的 HTTP URL，不允许其他协议
e_aia_ca_issuers_must_have_http_only.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_aia_must_contain_permitted_access_meth.en: The AIA must contain only the id-ad-ocsp or id-ad-caIssuers accessMethod. Others are not allowed. Also, each accessLocation MUST be encoded as uniformResourceIdentifier GeneralName.
e_aia_must_contain_permitted_access_meth.zh: AIA 只能包含 id-ad-ocsp 或 id-ad-caIssuers 访问方法，且每个访问位置必须编码为 uniformResourceIdentifier 通用名称形式
e_aia_must_contain_permitted_access_meth.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_aia_ocsp_must_have_http_only.en: The id-ad-ocsp accessMethod must contain an HTTP URL of the of the Issuing CA’s OCSP responder. Other schemes are not allowed.
e_aia_ocsp_must_have_http_only.zh: AIA 的 id-ad-ocsp 访问方法必须包含签发 CA 的 OCSP 响应器的 HTTP URL，不允许其他协议
e_aia_ocsp_must_have_http_only.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_aia_unique_access_locations.en: When multiple AccessDescriptions are present with the same accessMethod in the AIA extension, then each accessLocation MUST be unique.
e_aia_unique_access_locations.zh: AIA 中同一访问方法有多个 AccessDescription 时，每个访问位置必须唯一
e_aia_unique_access_locations.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_algorithm_identifier_improper_encoding.en: Encoded AlgorithmObjectIdentifier objects inside a SubjectPublicKeyInfo field
e_algorithm_identifier_improper_encoding.zh: SubjectPublicKeyInfo 中的算法对象标识符（AlgorithmObjectIdentifier）必须正确编码
e_algorithm_identifier_improper_encoding.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_arpa_domain_not_allowed.en: CAs SHALL NOT issue Certificates containing Domain Names that end in an IP Reverse Zone Suffix
e_arpa_domain_not_allowed.zh: CA 不得签发包含以 IP 反向解析后缀（.arpa 保留区）结尾的域名的证书
e_arpa_domain_not_allowed.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_br_prohibit_dsa_usage.en: DSA was removed from the Baseline Requirements as a valid signature algorithm in 1.7.1.
e_br_prohibit_dsa_usage.zh: 基线要求 1.7.1 起 DSA 不再是允许的签名算法
e_br_prohibit_dsa_usage.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_ca_aia_non_http_url.en: Within the AIA extension of CA certificates, accessLocations must contain HTTP URLs
e_ca_aia_non_http_url.zh: CA 证书 AIA 扩展中的访问位置必须包含 HTTP URL
e_ca_aia_non_http_url.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_ca_common_name_missing.en: CA Certificates common name MUST be included.
e_ca_common_name_missing.zh: CA 证书必须包含 Common Name（CN）
e_ca_common_name_missing.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_ca_country_name_invalid.en: Root and Subordinate CA certificates MUST have a two-letter country code specified in ISO 3166-1
e_ca_country_name_invalid.zh: 根 CA 和下级 CA 证书必须使用 ISO 3166-1 规定的两位国家代码
e_ca_country_name_invalid.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_ca_country_name_missing.en: Root and Subordinate CA certificates MUST have a countryName present in subject information
e_ca_country_name_missing.zh: 根 CA 和下级 CA 证书的 subject 中必须存在 countryName（国家）字段
e_ca_country_name_missing.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_ca_crl_sign_not_set.en: Root and Subordinate CA certificate keyUsage extension's crlSign bit MUST be set
e_ca_crl_sign_not_set.zh: 根 CA 和下级 CA 证书 keyUsage 扩展的 cRLSign 位必须设置
e_ca_crl_sign_not_set.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_ca_invalid_eku.en: Checks that SubCA certificates do not contain forbidden values in their EKU extension.
e_ca_invalid_eku.zh: 检查下级 CA 证书 EKU 扩展中不得包含禁止的值
e_ca_invalid_eku.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_ca_is_ca.en: Root and Sub CA Certificate: The CA field MUST be set to true.
e_ca_is_ca.zh: 根 CA 和下级 CA 证书的 basicConstraints cA 字段必须为 true
e_ca_is_ca.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_ca_key_cert_sign_not_set.en: CA Certificate Key Usage: Bit position for keyCertSign is REQUIRED.
e_ca_key_cert_sign_not_set.zh: CA 证书 KeyUsage 必须设置 keyCertSign（证书签名）位
e_ca_key_cert_sign_not_set.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_ca_key_usage_missing.en: Root and Subordinate CA certificate keyUsage extension MUST be present
e_ca_key_usage_missing.zh: 根 CA 和下级 CA 证书必须包含 keyUsage 扩展
e_ca_key_usage_missing.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_ca_key_usage_not_critical.en: Root and Subordinate CA certificate keyUsage extension MUST be marked as critical
e_ca_key_usage_not_critical.zh: 根 CA 和下级 CA 证书的 keyUsage 扩展必须标记为 critical
e_ca_key_usage_not_critical.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_ca_multiple_reserved_policy_oids.en: The CA MUST include exactly one Reserved Certificate Policy Identifier
e_ca_multiple_reserved_policy_oids.zh: CA 证书必须且只能包含一个 CA/B Forum 保留证书策略标识符
e_ca_multiple_reserved_policy_oids.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_ca_organization_name_missing.en: Root and Subordinate CA certificates MUST have an organizationName present in subject information
e_ca_organization_name_missing.zh: 根 CA 和下级 CA 证书的 subject 中必须存在 organizationName（组织名）
e_ca_organization_name_missing.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_cab_crl_has_valid_reason_code.en: Only the following CRLReasons MAY be present: 1, 3, 4, 5, 9.
e_cab_crl_has_valid_reason_code.zh: CRL 吊销原因码只允许为 1、3、4、5、9
e_cab_crl_has_valid_reason_code.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_cab_crl_reason_code_not_critical.en: If present, CRL Reason Code extension MUST NOT be marked critical.
e_cab_crl_reason_code_not_critical.zh: CRL 吊销原因码扩展如果存在，不得标记为 critical
e_cab_crl_reason_code_not_critical.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_cab_dv_conflicts_with_locality.en: If certificate policy 2.23.140.1.2.1 (CA/B BR domain validated) is included, locality name MUST NOT be included in subject
e_cab_dv_conflicts_with_locality.zh: 含 DV 策略（2.23.140.1.2.1）的证书，subject 中不得包含 localityName（地区名）
e_cab_dv_conflicts_with_locality.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_cab_dv_conflicts_with_org.en: If certificate policy 2.23.140.1.2.1 (CA/B BR domain validated) is included, organization name MUST NOT be included in subject
e_cab_dv_conflicts_with_org.zh: 含 DV 策略（2.23.140.1.2.1）的证书，subject 中不得包含 organizationName（组织名）
e_cab_dv_conflicts_with_org.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_cab_dv_conflicts_with_postal.en: If certificate policy 2.23.140.1.2.1 (CA/B BR domain validated) is included, postalCode MUST NOT be included in subject
e_cab_dv_conflicts_with_postal.zh: 含 DV 策略（2.23.140.1.2.1）的证书，subject 中不得包含 postalCode（邮编）
e_cab_dv_conflicts_with_postal.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_cab_dv_conflicts_with_province.en: If certificate policy 2.23.140.1.2.1 (CA/B BR domain validated) is included, stateOrProvinceName MUST NOT be included in subject
e_cab_dv_conflicts_with_province.zh: 含 DV 策略（2.23.140.1.2.1）的证书，subject 中不得包含 stateOrProvinceName（省/州）
e_cab_dv_conflicts_with_province.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_cab_dv_conflicts_with_street.en: If certificate policy 2.23.140.1.2.1 (CA/B BR domain validated) is included, streetAddress MUST NOT be included in subject
e_cab_dv_conflicts_with_street.zh: 含 DV 策略（2.23.140.1.2.1）的证书，subject 中不得包含 streetAddress（街道地址）
e_cab_dv_conflicts_with_street.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_cab_dv_subject_invalid_values.en: If certificate policy 2.23.140.1.2.1 (CA/B BR domain validated) is included, only country and/or common name is allowed in SubjectDN.
e_cab_dv_subject_invalid_values.zh: 含 DV 策略（2.23.140.1.2.1）的证书，SubjectDN 只允许 country 和/或 commonName
e_cab_dv_subject_invalid_values.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_cab_iv_requires_personal_name.en: If certificate policy 2.23.140.1.2.3 is included, either organizationName or givenName and surname MUST be included in subject
e_cab_iv_requires_personal_name.zh: 含 IV 策略（2.23.140.1.2.3）的证书，subject 中必须包含 organizationName 或 givenName 加 surname
e_cab_iv_requires_personal_name.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_cab_iv_requires_personal_name_strict.en: If certificate policy 2.23.140.1.2.3 is included givenName and surname MUST be included in subject
e_cab_iv_requires_personal_name_strict.zh: 含 IV 策略（2.23.140.1.2.3）的证书，subject 中必须包含 givenName 和 surname（严格模式）
e_cab_iv_requires_personal_name_strict.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_cab_ov_requires_org.en: If certificate policy 2.23.140.1.2.2 is included, organizationName MUST be included in subject
e_cab_ov_requires_org.zh: 含 OV 策略（2.23.140.1.2.2）的证书，subject 中必须包含 organizationName
e_cab_ov_requires_org.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_cabf_ecc_allowed_key_usages.en: For certificates with ECC public keys, digitalSignature MUST be present and only digitalSignature and keyAgreement key usages are allowed.
e_cabf_ecc_allowed_key_usages.zh: ECC 公钥证书必须设置 digitalSignature，且只允许 digitalSignature 和 keyAgreement 密钥用途
e_cabf_ecc_allowed_key_usages.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_cert_policy_iv_requires_country.en: If certificate policy 2.23.140.1.2.3 is included, countryName MUST be included in subject
e_cert_policy_iv_requires_country.zh: 含 IV 策略（2.23.140.1.2.3）的证书，subject 中必须包含 countryName
e_cert_policy_iv_requires_country.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_cert_policy_iv_requires_province_or_lo.en: If certificate policy 2.23.140.1.2.3 is included, localityName or stateOrProvinceName MUST be included in subject
e_cert_policy_iv_requires_province_or_lo.zh: 含 IV 策略（2.23.140.1.2.3）的证书，subject 中必须包含 localityName 或 stateOrProvinceName
e_cert_policy_iv_requires_province_or_lo.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_cert_policy_ov_requires_country.en: If certificate policy 2.23.140.1.2.2 is included, countryName MUST be included in subject
e_cert_policy_ov_requires_country.zh: 含 OV 策略（2.23.140.1.2.2）的证书，subject 中必须包含 countryName
e_cert_policy_ov_requires_country.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_cert_policy_ov_requires_province_or_lo.en: If certificate policy 2.23.140.1.2.2 is included, localityName or stateOrProvinceName MUST be included in subject
e_cert_policy_ov_requires_province_or_lo.zh: 含 OV 策略（2.23.140.1.2.2）的证书，subject 中必须包含 localityName 或 stateOrProvinceName
e_cert_policy_ov_requires_province_or_lo.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_crl_auth_key_id_only_contains_keyid.en: The AuthKey extension must only contain the KeyIdentifier field.
e_crl_auth_key_id_only_contains_keyid.zh: CRL 的权威密钥标识符（AKI）扩展只能包含 KeyIdentifier 字段
e_crl_auth_key_id_only_contains_keyid.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_crl_distrib_points_not_http.en: The scheme of each CRL Distribution Point MUST be 'http'
e_crl_distrib_points_not_http.zh: 每个 CRL 分发点的协议必须为 http
e_crl_distrib_points_not_http.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_crl_extensions_validity.en: Checks that only allowed extensions are present in a CRL and that their criticality is set correctly.
e_crl_extensions_validity.zh: 检查 CRL 中只能出现允许的扩展，且其 critical 标记正确
e_crl_extensions_validity.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_crl_next_update_invalid.en: For CRLs covering (EE|CA) certificates, nextUpdate must be at most (10 days|12 months) beyond thisUpdate
e_crl_next_update_invalid.zh: CRL 的 nextUpdate 最迟不得超过 thisUpdate 后 10 天（EE 证书）或 12 个月（CA 证书）
e_crl_next_update_invalid.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_crl_number_out_of_range.en: The CRL number must be greater than or equal to 0 and less than 2^159.
e_crl_number_out_of_range.zh: CRL 编号必须大于等于 0 且小于 2^159
e_crl_number_out_of_range.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_crlissuer_must_not_be_present_in_cdp.en: crlIssuer and/or Reason field MUST NOT be present in the CDP extension.
e_crlissuer_must_not_be_present_in_cdp.zh: CDP 扩展中不得包含 cRLIssuer 和/或 Reason 字段
e_crlissuer_must_not_be_present_in_cdp.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_dnsname_bad_character_in_label.en: Characters in labels of DNSNames MUST be alphanumeric, - , _ or *
e_dnsname_bad_character_in_label.zh: DNS 名称标签中的字符必须为字母数字、-、_ 或 *
e_dnsname_bad_character_in_label.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_dnsname_contains_bare_iana_suffix.en: DNSNames should not contain a bare IANA suffix.
e_dnsname_contains_bare_iana_suffix.zh: DNS 名称不得包含裸的 IANA 后缀（如裸 TLD）
e_dnsname_contains_bare_iana_suffix.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_dnsname_contains_prohibited_reserved_l.en: FQDNs MUST consist solely of Domain Labels that are P‐Labels or Non‐Reserved LDH Labels
e_dnsname_contains_prohibited_reserved_l.zh: FQDN 必须完全由 P 标签（punycode）或非保留的 LDH 标签构成
e_dnsname_contains_prohibited_reserved_l.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_dnsname_empty_label.en: DNSNames should not have an empty label.
e_dnsname_empty_label.zh: DNS 名称不得有空标签（如 foo..com）
e_dnsname_empty_label.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_dnsname_hyphen_in_sld.en: DNSName should not have a hyphen beginning or ending the SLD
e_dnsname_hyphen_in_sld.zh: DNS 名称的二级域名（SLD）不得以连字符开头或结尾
e_dnsname_hyphen_in_sld.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_dnsname_label_too_long.en: DNSName labels MUST be less than or equal to 63 characters
e_dnsname_label_too_long.zh: DNS 名称标签长度必须小于等于 63 字符
e_dnsname_label_too_long.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_dnsname_left_label_wildcard_correct.en: Wildcards in the left label of DNSName should only be *
e_dnsname_left_label_wildcard_correct.zh: DNS 名称最左侧标签中的通配符只能是 *
e_dnsname_left_label_wildcard_correct.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_dnsname_not_valid_tld.en: DNSNames must have a valid TLD.
e_dnsname_not_valid_tld.zh: DNS 名称必须使用有效的顶级域名（TLD）
e_dnsname_not_valid_tld.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_dnsname_underscore_in_sld.en: DNSName MUST NOT contain underscore characters
e_dnsname_underscore_in_sld.zh: DNS 名称不得包含下划线字符
e_dnsname_underscore_in_sld.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_dnsname_wildcard_only_in_left_label.en: DNSName should not have wildcards except in the left-most label
e_dnsname_wildcard_only_in_left_label.zh: 通配符只能出现在 DNS 名称的最左侧标签
e_dnsname_wildcard_only_in_left_label.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_dsa_correct_order_in_subgroup.en: DSA: Public key value has the unique correct representation in the field, and that the key has the correct order in the subgroup
e_dsa_correct_order_in_subgroup.zh: DSA 公钥值必须在域中具有唯一正确表示，且密钥在子群中具有正确的阶
e_dsa_correct_order_in_subgroup.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_dsa_improper_modulus_or_divisor_size.en: Certificates MUST meet the following requirements for DSA algorithm type and key size: L=2048 and N=224,256 or L=3072 and N=256
e_dsa_improper_modulus_or_divisor_size.zh: DSA 算法类型和密钥大小必须满足：L=2048 且 N=224/256，或 L=3072 且 N=256
e_dsa_improper_modulus_or_divisor_size.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_dsa_params_missing.en: DSA: Certificates MUST include all domain parameters
e_dsa_params_missing.zh: DSA 证书必须包含全部域参数（p、q、g）
e_dsa_params_missing.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_dsa_shorter_than_2048_bits.en: DSA modulus size must be at least 2048 bits
e_dsa_shorter_than_2048_bits.zh: DSA 模数长度必须至少为 2048 位
e_dsa_shorter_than_2048_bits.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_dsa_unique_correct_representation.en: DSA: Public key value has the unique correct representation in the field, and that the key has the correct order in the subgroup
e_dsa_unique_correct_representation.zh: DSA 公钥值必须在域中具有唯一正确表示，且密钥在子群中具有正确的阶
e_dsa_unique_correct_representation.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_duplicate_subject_attribs.en: Each Name MUST NOT contain more than one instance of a given AttributeTypeAndValue across all RDNs
e_duplicate_subject_attribs.zh: 所有 RDN 中不得有多个相同的属性类型和值（AttributeTypeAndValue）
e_duplicate_subject_attribs.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_ec_improper_curves.en: Only one of NIST P‐256, P‐384, or P‐521 can be used
e_ec_improper_curves.zh: 只允许使用 NIST P-256、P-384、P-521 椭圆曲线
e_ec_improper_curves.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_eku_critical.en: Subscriber Certificate extkeyUsage extension MUST NOT be marked critical
e_eku_critical.zh: 订户（叶子）证书的 extkeyUsage 扩展不得标记为 critical
e_eku_critical.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_excessively backdated.en: notBefore [must be] a value within 48 hours of the certificate signing
e_excessively backdated.zh: 证书 notBefore 必须在证书签发时间前 48 小时之内
e_excessively backdated.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_ext_nc_intersects_reserved_ip.en: iPAddress name constraint intersects an IANA reserved network
e_ext_nc_intersects_reserved_ip.zh: iPAddress 名称约束与 IANA 保留网络地址相交
e_ext_nc_intersects_reserved_ip.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_ext_san_contains_reserved_ip.en: CAs SHALL NOT issue certificates with a subjectAltName extension or subject:commonName field containing a Reserved IP Address or Internal Name.
e_ext_san_contains_reserved_ip.zh: CA 不得签发 SAN 扩展或 subject:commonName 含保留 IP 地址或内部名称的证书
e_ext_san_contains_reserved_ip.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_ext_san_directory_name_present.en: The Subject Alternate Name extension MUST contain only 'dnsName' and 'ipaddress' name types
e_ext_san_directory_name_present.zh: SAN 扩展只允许包含 dnsName 和 ipAddress 名称类型（不允许 directoryName）
e_ext_san_directory_name_present.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_ext_san_edi_party_name_present.en: The Subject Alternate Name extension MUST contain only 'dnsName' and 'ipaddress' name types
e_ext_san_edi_party_name_present.zh: SAN 扩展只允许包含 dnsName 和 ipAddress 名称类型（不允许 ediPartyName）
e_ext_san_edi_party_name_present.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_ext_san_missing.en: Subscriber certificates MUST contain the Subject Alternate Name extension
e_ext_san_missing.zh: 订户证书必须包含 SAN（主题备用名称）扩展
e_ext_san_missing.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_ext_san_other_name_present.en: The Subject Alternate Name extension MUST contain only 'dnsName' and 'ipaddress' name types.
e_ext_san_other_name_present.zh: SAN 扩展只允许包含 dnsName 和 ipAddress 名称类型（不允许 otherName）
e_ext_san_other_name_present.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_ext_san_registered_id_present.en: The Subject Alternate Name extension MUST contain only 'dnsName' and 'ipaddress' name types.
e_ext_san_registered_id_present.zh: SAN 扩展只允许包含 dnsName 和 ipAddress 名称类型（不允许 registeredID）
e_ext_san_registered_id_present.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_ext_san_rfc822_name_present.en: The Subject Alternate Name extension MUST contain only 'dnsName' and 'ipaddress' name types.
e_ext_san_rfc822_name_present.zh: SAN 扩展只允许包含 dnsName 和 ipAddress 名称类型（不允许 rfc822Name 邮箱）
e_ext_san_rfc822_name_present.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_ext_san_uniform_resource_identifier_pr.en: The Subject Alternate Name extension MUST contain only 'dnsName' and 'ipaddress' name types
e_ext_san_uniform_resource_identifier_pr.zh: SAN 扩展只允许包含 dnsName 和 ipAddress 名称类型（不允许 URI）
e_ext_san_uniform_resource_identifier_pr.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_ext_tor_service_descriptor_hash_invali.en: certificates with v2 .onion names need valid TorServiceDescriptors in extension
e_ext_tor_service_descriptor_hash_invali.zh: 含 v2 .onion 域名的证书必须在扩展中提供有效的 Tor 服务描述符哈希
e_ext_tor_service_descriptor_hash_invali.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_invalid_ca_certificate_policies.en: Checks that the Policy OIDs in the CertificatePolicies extension of a SubCA certificate comply with CABF requirements
e_invalid_ca_certificate_policies.zh: 检查下级 CA 证书 certificatePolicies 扩展中的策略 OID 是否符合 CABF 要求
e_invalid_ca_certificate_policies.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_invalid_certificate_version.en: Certificates MUST be of type X.509 v3
e_invalid_certificate_version.zh: 证书必须是 X.509 v3 版本
e_invalid_certificate_version.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_invalid_cps_uri.en: If the CPS URI policyQualifier is present in a certificate, it MUST contain an HTTP or HTTPS URL
e_invalid_cps_uri.zh: 证书中的 CPS URI 策略限定符必须为 HTTP 或 HTTPS URL
e_invalid_cps_uri.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_invalid_subject_rdn_order.en: Subject field attributes (RDNs) SHALL be encoded in a specific order
e_invalid_subject_rdn_order.zh: subject 字段的属性（RDN）必须按特定顺序编码
e_invalid_subject_rdn_order.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_missing_crl_distrib_point.en: Checks for the CDP extension in non-Short-lived Subscriber Certificates lacking an OCSP pointer
e_missing_crl_distrib_point.zh: 非短期订户证书若没有 OCSP 指针，则必须包含 CDP 扩展
e_missing_crl_distrib_point.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_no_underscores_before_1_6_2.en: Before explicitly stating as such in CABF 1.6.2, the stance of RFC5280 is adopted that DNSNames MUST NOT contain an underscore character.
e_no_underscores_before_1_6_2.zh: 在 CABF 1.6.2 明确允许之前，遵循 RFC5280 立场：DNS 名称不得含下划线
e_no_underscores_before_1_6_2.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_ocsp_cert_cdp_forbidden.en: In OCSP certificates, the CDP extension MUST NOT appear
e_ocsp_cert_cdp_forbidden.zh: OCSP 响应签名证书不得包含 CDP 扩展
e_ocsp_cert_cdp_forbidden.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_ocsp_cert_cp_forbidden.en: In OCSP certificates, the CP extension MUST NOT appear
e_ocsp_cert_cp_forbidden.zh: OCSP 响应签名证书不得包含 CP（证书策略）扩展
e_ocsp_cert_cp_forbidden.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_ocsp_cert_invalid_ku.en: For OCSP certificates, only digitalSignature is allowed in the KU ext
e_ocsp_cert_invalid_ku.zh: OCSP 响应签名证书的 KeyUsage 只允许 digitalSignature
e_ocsp_cert_invalid_ku.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_ocsp_id_pkix_ocsp_nocheck_ext_not_incl.en: OCSP signing Certificate MUST contain an extension of type id-pkixocsp-nocheck, as
e_ocsp_id_pkix_ocsp_nocheck_ext_not_incl.zh: OCSP 签名证书必须包含 id-pkix-ocsp-nocheck 扩展
e_ocsp_id_pkix_ocsp_nocheck_ext_not_incl.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_old_root_ca_rsa_mod_less_than_2048_bit.en: In a validity period beginning on or before 31 Dec 2010, root CA certificates using RSA public key algorithm MUST use a 2048 bit modulus
e_old_root_ca_rsa_mod_less_than_2048_bit.zh: 有效期始于 2010-12-31 之前的根 CA 证书，RSA 模数必须为 2048 位
e_old_root_ca_rsa_mod_less_than_2048_bit.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_old_sub_ca_rsa_mod_less_than_1024_bits.en: In a validity period beginning on or before 31 Dec 2010 and ending on or before 31 Dec 2013, subordinate CA certificates using RSA public key algorithm MUST use a 1024 bit modulus
e_old_sub_ca_rsa_mod_less_than_1024_bits.zh: 有效期始于 2010-12-31 前且止于 2013-12-31 前的下级 CA 证书，RSA 模数必须为 1024 位
e_old_sub_ca_rsa_mod_less_than_1024_bits.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_old_sub_cert_rsa_mod_less_than_1024_bi.en: In a validity period ending on or before 31 Dec 2013, subscriber certificates using RSA public key algorithm MUST use a 1024 bit modulus
e_old_sub_cert_rsa_mod_less_than_1024_bi.zh: 有效期止于 2013-12-31 前的订户证书，RSA 模数必须为 1024 位
e_old_sub_cert_rsa_mod_less_than_1024_bi.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_organizational_unit_name_prohibited.en: OrganizationalUnitName is prohibited if...the certificate was issued on or after September 1, 2022
e_organizational_unit_name_prohibited.zh: 2022-09-01 起签发的证书禁止使用 OrganizationalUnitName（OU）
e_organizational_unit_name_prohibited.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_policy_qualifiers_other_than_cps_not_p.en: Policy Qualifiers other than id-qt-cps MUST NOT be present for certificates issued on or after September 15, 2023
e_policy_qualifiers_other_than_cps_not_p.zh: 2023-09-15 起签发的证书不得包含除 id-qt-cps 之外的策略限定符
e_policy_qualifiers_other_than_cps_not_p.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_public_key_type_not_allowed.en: Certificates MUST have RSA, DSA, or ECDSA public key type
e_public_key_type_not_allowed.zh: 证书公钥类型必须为 RSA、DSA 或 ECDSA
e_public_key_type_not_allowed.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_root_ca_extended_key_usage_present.en: Root CA Certificate: extendedKeyUsage MUST NOT be present.t
e_root_ca_extended_key_usage_present.zh: 根 CA 证书不得包含 extendedKeyUsage 扩展
e_root_ca_extended_key_usage_present.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_root_ca_key_usage_must_be_critical.en: Root CA certificates MUST have Key Usage Extension marked critical
e_root_ca_key_usage_must_be_critical.zh: 根 CA 证书的 KeyUsage 扩展必须标记为 critical
e_root_ca_key_usage_must_be_critical.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_root_ca_key_usage_present.en: Root CA certificates MUST have Key Usage Extension Present
e_root_ca_key_usage_present.zh: 根 CA 证书必须包含 KeyUsage 扩展
e_root_ca_key_usage_present.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_rsa_mod_less_than_2048_bits.en: For certificates valid after 31 Dec 2013, all certificates using RSA public key algorithm MUST have 2048 bits of modulus
e_rsa_mod_less_than_2048_bits.zh: 2013-12-31 后有效的所有 RSA 证书，模数必须为 2048 位
e_rsa_mod_less_than_2048_bits.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_rsa_public_exponent_not_odd.en: RSA: Value of public exponent is an odd number equal to 3 or more.
e_rsa_public_exponent_not_odd.zh: RSA 公钥指数必须为大于等于 3 的奇数
e_rsa_public_exponent_not_odd.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_rsa_public_exponent_too_small.en: RSA: Value of public exponent is an odd number equal to 3 or more.
e_rsa_public_exponent_too_small.zh: RSA 公钥指数必须为大于等于 3 的奇数（且实践中应大于 65536）
e_rsa_public_exponent_too_small.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_san_dns_name_onion_invalid.en: certificates with a .onion subject name must be issued in accordance with the Tor address/rendezvous specification
e_san_dns_name_onion_invalid.zh: 含 .onion 主体的证书必须按 Tor 地址/rendezvous 规范签发
e_san_dns_name_onion_invalid.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_san_dns_name_onion_not_ev_cert.en: certificates with a .onion subject name must be issued in accordance with EV Guidelines
e_san_dns_name_onion_not_ev_cert.zh: 含 .onion 主体的证书必须符合 EV 指南要求
e_san_dns_name_onion_not_ev_cert.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_server_cert_valid_time_longer_than_100.en: TLS server certificates issued on or after on or after March 15, 2027 00:00 GMT/UTC must not have a validity period greater than 100 days
e_server_cert_valid_time_longer_than_100.zh: 2027-03-15 起签发的 TLS 服务器证书有效期不得超过 100 天
e_server_cert_valid_time_longer_than_100.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_server_cert_valid_time_longer_than_200.en: TLS server certificates issued on or after on or after March 15, 2026 00:00 GMT/UTC must not have a validity period greater than 200 days
e_server_cert_valid_time_longer_than_200.zh: 2026-03-15 起签发的 TLS 服务器证书有效期不得超过 200 天
e_server_cert_valid_time_longer_than_200.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_server_cert_valid_time_longer_than_47_.en: TLS server certificates issued on or after on or after March 15, 2029 00:00 GMT/UTC must not have a validity period greater than 47 days
e_server_cert_valid_time_longer_than_47_.zh: 2029-03-15 起签发的 TLS 服务器证书有效期不得超过 47 天
e_server_cert_valid_time_longer_than_47_.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_signature_algorithm_not_supported.en: Certificates MUST meet the following requirements for algorithm Source: SHA-1*, SHA-256, SHA-384, SHA-512
e_signature_algorithm_not_supported.zh: 证书签名算法必须为 SHA-256、SHA-384、SHA-512（及限定的 SHA-1）
e_signature_algorithm_not_supported.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_state_or_province_name_must_not_contai.en: stateOrProvinceName MUST come from an authoritative data source of plain, human readable, names
e_state_or_province_name_must_not_contai.zh: stateOrProvinceName 必须来自权威数据源且为纯人类可读名称（无控制字符）
e_state_or_province_name_must_not_contai.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_sub_ca_aia_marked_critical.en: Subordinate CA Certificate: authorityInformationAccess MUST NOT be marked critical
e_sub_ca_aia_marked_critical.zh: 下级 CA 证书的 authorityInformationAccess（AIA）不得标记为 critical
e_sub_ca_aia_marked_critical.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_sub_ca_aia_missing.en: Subordinate CA Certificate: authorityInformationAccess MUST be present, with the exception of stapling.
e_sub_ca_aia_missing.zh: 下级 CA 证书必须包含 AIA 扩展（OCSP 装订情况除外）
e_sub_ca_aia_missing.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_sub_ca_certificate_policies_missing.en: Subordinate CA certificates must have a certificatePolicies extension
e_sub_ca_certificate_policies_missing.zh: 下级 CA 证书必须包含 certificatePolicies 扩展
e_sub_ca_certificate_policies_missing.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_sub_ca_crl_distribution_points_does_no.en: Subordinate CA Certificate: cRLDistributionPoints MUST contain the HTTP URL of the CA's CRL service.
e_sub_ca_crl_distribution_points_does_no.zh: 下级 CA 证书的 cRLDistributionPoints 必须包含 CA 的 CRL 服务的 HTTP URL
e_sub_ca_crl_distribution_points_does_no.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_sub_ca_crl_distribution_points_marked_.en: Subordinate CA Certificate: cRLDistributionPoints MUST be present and MUST NOT be marked critical.
e_sub_ca_crl_distribution_points_marked_.zh: 下级 CA 证书的 cRLDistributionPoints 必须存在且不得标记为 critical
e_sub_ca_crl_distribution_points_marked_.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_sub_ca_crl_distribution_points_missing.en: Subordinate CA Certificate: cRLDistributionPoints MUST be present and MUST NOT be marked critical.
e_sub_ca_crl_distribution_points_missing.zh: 下级 CA 证书必须包含 cRLDistributionPoints 扩展且不得标记为 critical
e_sub_ca_crl_distribution_points_missing.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_sub_cert_aia_does_not_contain_ocsp_url.en: Subscriber Certificate: authorityInformationAccess MUST contain the HTTP URL of the Issuing CA's OSCP responder.
e_sub_cert_aia_does_not_contain_ocsp_url.zh: 订户证书的 AIA 必须包含签发 CA 的 OCSP 响应器的 HTTP URL
e_sub_cert_aia_does_not_contain_ocsp_url.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_sub_cert_aia_marked_critical.en: Subscriber Certificate: authorityInformationAccess MUST NOT be marked critical
e_sub_cert_aia_marked_critical.zh: 订户证书的 authorityInformationAccess 不得标记为 critical
e_sub_cert_aia_marked_critical.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_sub_cert_aia_missing.en: Subscriber Certificate: authorityInformationAccess MUST be present.
e_sub_cert_aia_missing.zh: 订户证书必须包含 authorityInformationAccess（AIA）扩展
e_sub_cert_aia_missing.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_sub_cert_basic_constraints_not_critica.en: basicConstraints MAY appear in the certificate, and when it is included MUST be marked as critical
e_sub_cert_basic_constraints_not_critica.zh: 订户证书若包含 basicConstraints 扩展必须标记为 critical
e_sub_cert_basic_constraints_not_critica.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_sub_cert_cert_policy_empty.en: Subscriber certificates must contain at least one policy identifier that indicates adherence to CAB standards
e_sub_cert_cert_policy_empty.zh: 订户证书必须包含至少一个表明遵循 CABF 标准的策略标识符
e_sub_cert_cert_policy_empty.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_sub_cert_certificate_policies_missing.en: Subscriber Certificate: certificatePolicies MUST be present and SHOULD NOT be marked critical.
e_sub_cert_certificate_policies_missing.zh: 订户证书必须包含 certificatePolicies 扩展，且不应标记为 critical
e_sub_cert_certificate_policies_missing.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_sub_cert_country_name_must_appear.en: Subscriber Certificate: subject:countryName MUST appear if the subject:organizationName field, subject:givenName field, or subject:surname fields are present.
e_sub_cert_country_name_must_appear.zh: 订户证书若 subject 含 organizationName、givenName 或 surname，则必须包含 countryName
e_sub_cert_country_name_must_appear.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_sub_cert_crl_distribution_points_does_.en: Subscriber certificate cRLDistributionPoints extension must contain the HTTP URL of the CA’s CRL service
e_sub_cert_crl_distribution_points_does_.zh: 订户证书 cRLDistributionPoints 扩展必须包含 CA 的 CRL 服务的 HTTP URL
e_sub_cert_crl_distribution_points_does_.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_sub_cert_crl_distribution_points_marke.en: Subscriber Certificate: cRLDistributionPoints MUST NOT be marked critical, and MUST contain the HTTP URL of the CA's CRL service.
e_sub_cert_crl_distribution_points_marke.zh: 订户证书的 cRLDistributionPoints 不得标记为 critical，且必须包含 CRL 服务的 HTTP URL
e_sub_cert_crl_distribution_points_marke.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_sub_cert_eku_check.en: Subscriber certificates MUST have id-kp-serverAuth and MAY have id-kp-clientAuth present in extKeyUsage
e_sub_cert_eku_check.zh: 订户证书的 extKeyUsage 必须包含 id-kp-serverAuth，可以包含 id-kp-clientAuth
e_sub_cert_eku_check.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_sub_cert_eku_missing.en: Subscriber certificates MUST have the extended key usage extension present
e_sub_cert_eku_missing.zh: 订户证书必须包含 extended key usage（EKU）扩展
e_sub_cert_eku_missing.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_sub_cert_eku_server_auth_client_auth_m.en: Subscriber certificates MUST have either id-kp-serverAuth or id-kp-clientAuth or both present in extKeyUsage
e_sub_cert_eku_server_auth_client_auth_m.zh: 订户证书的 extKeyUsage 必须包含 id-kp-serverAuth 或 id-kp-clientAuth 之一或两者
e_sub_cert_eku_server_auth_client_auth_m.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_sub_cert_given_name_surname_contains_c.en: Subscriber Certificate: A certificate containing a subject:givenName field or subject:surname field MUST contain the (2.23.140.1.2.3) certPolicy OID.
e_sub_cert_given_name_surname_contains_c.zh: 含 givenName 或 surname 的订户证书必须包含 IV 策略 OID（2.23.140.1.2.3）
e_sub_cert_given_name_surname_contains_c.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_sub_cert_key_usage_cert_sign_bit_set.en: Subscriber Certificate: keyUsage if present, bit positions for keyCertSign and cRLSign MUST NOT be set.
e_sub_cert_key_usage_cert_sign_bit_set.zh: 订户证书若含 keyUsage，不得设置 keyCertSign 位
e_sub_cert_key_usage_cert_sign_bit_set.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_sub_cert_key_usage_crl_sign_bit_set.en: Subscriber Certificate: keyUsage if present, bit positions for keyCertSign and cRLSign MUST NOT be set.
e_sub_cert_key_usage_crl_sign_bit_set.zh: 订户证书若含 keyUsage，不得设置 cRLSign 位
e_sub_cert_key_usage_crl_sign_bit_set.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_sub_cert_locality_name_must_appear.en: Subscriber Certificate: subject:localityName MUST appear if subject:organizationName, subject:givenName, or subject:surname fields are present but the subject:stateOrProvinceName field is absent.
e_sub_cert_locality_name_must_appear.zh: 订户证书 subject 含组织/个人名但无 stateOrProvinceName 时，必须包含 localityName
e_sub_cert_locality_name_must_appear.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_sub_cert_locality_name_must_not_appear.en: Subscriber Certificate: subject:localityName MUST NOT appear if subject:organizationName, subject:givenName, and subject:surname fields are absent.
e_sub_cert_locality_name_must_not_appear.zh: 订户证书 subject 不含组织/个人名时，不得包含 localityName
e_sub_cert_locality_name_must_not_appear.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_sub_cert_not_is_ca.en: Subscriber Certificate: basicContrainsts cA field MUST NOT be true.
e_sub_cert_not_is_ca.zh: 订户证书的 basicConstraints cA 字段不得为 true
e_sub_cert_not_is_ca.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_sub_cert_or_sub_ca_using_sha1.en: CAs MUST NOT issue any new Subscriber certificates or Subordinate CA certificates using SHA-1 after 1 January 2016
e_sub_cert_or_sub_ca_using_sha1.zh: 2016-01-01 之后 CA 不得使用 SHA-1 签发新的订户证书或下级 CA 证书
e_sub_cert_or_sub_ca_using_sha1.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_sub_cert_postal_code_must_not_appear.en: Subscriber Certificate: subject:postalCode MUST NOT appear if the subject:organizationName field, subject:givenName field, or subject:surname fields are absent.
e_sub_cert_postal_code_must_not_appear.zh: 订户证书 subject 不含组织/个人名时，不得包含 postalCode
e_sub_cert_postal_code_must_not_appear.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_sub_cert_province_must_appear.en: Subscriber Certificate: subject:stateOrProvinceName MUST appear if the subject:organizationName, subject:givenName, or subject:surname fields are present and subject:localityName is absent.
e_sub_cert_province_must_appear.zh: 订户证书 subject 含组织/个人名但无 localityName 时，必须包含 stateOrProvinceName
e_sub_cert_province_must_appear.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_sub_cert_province_must_not_appear.en: Subscriber Certificate: subject:stateOrProvinceName MUST NOT appear if the subject:organizationName, subject:givenName, and subject:surname fields are absent.
e_sub_cert_province_must_not_appear.zh: 订户证书 subject 不含组织/个人名时，不得包含 stateOrProvinceName
e_sub_cert_province_must_not_appear.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_sub_cert_street_address_should_not_exi.en: Subscriber Certificate: subject:streetAddress MUST NOT appear if subject:organizationName, subject:givenName, and subject:surname fields are absent.
e_sub_cert_street_address_should_not_exi.zh: 订户证书 subject 不含组织/个人名时，不得包含 streetAddress
e_sub_cert_street_address_should_not_exi.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_sub_cert_valid_time_longer_than_39_mon.en: Subscriber Certificates issued after 1 July 2016 but prior to 1 March 2018 MUST have a Validity Period no greater than 39 months.
e_sub_cert_valid_time_longer_than_39_mon.zh: 2016-07-01 至 2018-03-01 之间签发的订户证书有效期不得超过 39 个月
e_sub_cert_valid_time_longer_than_39_mon.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_sub_cert_valid_time_longer_than_825_da.en: Subscriber Certificates issued after 1 March 2018, but prior to 1 September 2020, MUST NOT have a Validity Period greater than 825 days.
e_sub_cert_valid_time_longer_than_825_da.zh: 2018-03-01 至 2020-09-01 之间签发的订户证书有效期不得超过 825 天
e_sub_cert_valid_time_longer_than_825_da.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_subj_orgunit_in_ca_cert.en: The organizationalUnitName MUST NOT be included in Root CA certs or TLS Subordinate CA certs. organizationalUnitName is allowed for cross signed certificates, although not recommended. This lint may be configured to signify that the target is a cross signed certificate.
e_subj_orgunit_in_ca_cert.zh: 根 CA 证书或 TLS 下级 CA 证书不得包含 organizationalUnitName（OU），交叉签名证书允许但不推荐
e_subj_orgunit_in_ca_cert.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_subject_common_name_not_exactly_from_s.en: The common name field in subscriber certificates must include only names from the SAN extension
e_subject_common_name_not_exactly_from_s.zh: 订户证书的 commonName 字段只能包含 SAN 扩展中的名称
e_subject_common_name_not_exactly_from_s.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_subject_common_name_not_from_san.en: The common name field in subscriber certificates must include only names from the SAN extension
e_subject_common_name_not_from_san.zh: 订户证书的 commonName 字段必须仅包含 SAN 扩展中的名称
e_subject_common_name_not_from_san.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_subject_contains_noninformational_valu.en: Subject name fields must not contain '.','-',' ' or any other indication that the field has been omitted
e_subject_contains_noninformational_valu.zh: subject 名称字段不得包含 '.'、'-'、' ' 等表示字段被省略的字符
e_subject_contains_noninformational_valu.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_subject_contains_organizational_unit_n.en: If a subject organization name is absent then an organizational unit name MUST NOT be included in subject
e_subject_contains_organizational_unit_n.zh: subject 缺少组织名时，不得包含组织单位名（OU）
e_subject_contains_organizational_unit_n.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_subject_contains_reserved_arpa_ip.en: Checks no subject domain name contains a rDNS entry in an .arpa zone specifying a reserved IP address
e_subject_contains_reserved_arpa_ip.zh: subject 域名不得包含 .arpa 反向解析区中指向保留 IP 地址的记录
e_subject_contains_reserved_arpa_ip.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_subject_contains_reserved_ip.en: Certificates expiring later than 11 Jan 2015 MUST NOT contain a reserved IP address in the common name field
e_subject_contains_reserved_ip.zh: 有效期晚于 2015-01-11 的证书，commonName 不得包含保留 IP 地址
e_subject_contains_reserved_ip.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_subject_country_not_iso.en: The country name field MUST contain the two-letter ISO code for the country or XX
e_subject_country_not_iso.zh: countryName 字段必须为两位 ISO 国家代码或 XX
e_subject_country_not_iso.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_subject_rdns_correct_encoding.en: CAs that include attributes in the Certificate subject field that are listed in the Tables 77 and 78 of BR 2.0.0 SHALL follow the specified encoding requirements for the attribute
e_subject_rdns_correct_encoding.zh: subject 中 BR 2.0.0 表 77、78 列出的属性必须按指定编码要求编码
e_subject_rdns_correct_encoding.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_underscore_not_permissible_in_dnsname.en: DNSNames MUST NOT contain underscore characters
e_underscore_not_permissible_in_dnsname.zh: DNS 名称不得包含下划线字符
e_underscore_not_permissible_in_dnsname.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_underscore_permissible_in_dnsname_if_v.en: From December 10th 2018 to April 1st 2019 DNSNames may contain underscores if-and-only-if every label within each DNS name is a valid LDH label after replacing all underscores with hyphens
e_underscore_permissible_in_dnsname_if_v.zh: 2018-12-10 至 2019-04-01 间，DNS 名称可含下划线，前提是每个标签将下划线替换为连字符后仍是合法 LDH 标签
e_underscore_permissible_in_dnsname_if_v.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_underscore_present_with_too_long_valid.en: From 2018-12-10 to 2019-04-01, DNSNames may contain underscores if-and-only-if the certificate is valid for less than thirty days.
e_underscore_present_with_too_long_valid.zh: 2018-12-10 至 2019-04-01 间，DNS 名称含下划线时证书有效期必须小于 30 天
e_underscore_present_with_too_long_valid.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

n_ca_digital_signature_not_set.en: Root and Subordinate CA Certificates that wish to use their private key for signing OCSP responses will not be able to without their digital signature set
n_ca_digital_signature_not_set.zh: 根 CA 和下级 CA 证书未设置 digitalSignature 位将无法用于签署 OCSP 响应
n_ca_digital_signature_not_set.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

n_dnsname_wildcard_left_of_public_suffix.en: the CA MUST establish and follow a documented procedure[^pubsuffix] that determines if the wildcard character occurs in the first label position to the left of a “registry‐controlled” label or “public suffix”
n_dnsname_wildcard_left_of_public_suffix.zh: CA 必须建立文档化流程，确定通配符出现在公共后缀左侧第一个标签位置
n_dnsname_wildcard_left_of_public_suffix.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

n_sub_ca_eku_missing.en: To be considered Technically Constrained, the Subordinate CA certificate MUST have extkeyUsage extension
n_sub_ca_eku_missing.zh: 为被视为技术上受约束，下级 CA 证书必须包含 extkeyUsage 扩展
n_sub_ca_eku_missing.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

n_sub_ca_eku_not_technically_constrained.en: Subordinate CA extkeyUsage, either id-kp-serverAuth or id-kp-clientAuth or both values MUST be present to be technically constrained.
n_sub_ca_eku_not_technically_constrained.zh: 下级 CA 的 extkeyUsage 必须包含 id-kp-serverAuth 或 id-kp-clientAuth 才被视为技术上受约束
n_sub_ca_eku_not_technically_constrained.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

n_subject_common_name_included.zh: 订户证书的 commonName 已废弃（信息提示）
n_subject_common_name_included.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

w_cabf_ecc_ku_keyagreement_present.en: For certificates with ECC public keys the keyAgreement key usage is allowed and not recommended.
w_cabf_ecc_ku_keyagreement_present.zh: ECC 公钥证书的 keyAgreement 密钥用途虽允许但不推荐
w_cabf_ecc_ku_keyagreement_present.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

w_dnsname_underscore_in_trd.en: DNSName MUST NOT contain underscore characters
w_dnsname_underscore_in_trd.zh: DNS 名称不得包含下划线字符（警告）
w_dnsname_underscore_in_trd.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

w_ext_san_critical_with_subject_dn.en: If the subject contains a distinguished name, subjectAlternateName SHOULD be non-critical
w_ext_san_critical_with_subject_dn.zh: subject 含可识别名称时，subjectAlternateName 应标记为非 critical
w_ext_san_critical_with_subject_dn.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

w_ext_subject_key_identifier_not_recomme.en: Subscriber certificates use of Subject Key Identifier is NOT RECOMMENDED
w_ext_subject_key_identifier_not_recomme.zh: 订户证书使用 Subject Key Identifier 不推荐
w_ext_subject_key_identifier_not_recomme.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

w_extra_subject_common_names.en: if present the subject commonName field MUST contain a single IP address or Fully-Qualified Domain Name
w_extra_subject_common_names.zh: subject commonName 字段若存在必须包含单个 IP 地址或 FQDN
w_extra_subject_common_names.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

w_root_ca_basic_constraints_path_len_con.en: Root CA certificate basicConstraint extension pathLenConstraint field SHOULD NOT be present
w_root_ca_basic_constraints_path_len_con.zh: 根 CA 证书 basicConstraints 的 pathLenConstraint 字段不应存在
w_root_ca_basic_constraints_path_len_con.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

w_root_ca_contains_cert_policy.en: Root CA Certificate: certificatePolicies SHOULD NOT be present.
w_root_ca_contains_cert_policy.zh: 根 CA 证书不应包含 certificatePolicies 扩展
w_root_ca_contains_cert_policy.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

w_rsa_mod_factors_smaller_than_752.en: RSA: Modulus SHOULD also have the following characteristics: no factors smaller than 752
w_rsa_mod_factors_smaller_than_752.zh: RSA 模数不应有小于 752 的因子
w_rsa_mod_factors_smaller_than_752.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

w_rsa_mod_not_odd.en: RSA: Modulus SHOULD also have the following characteristics: an odd number
w_rsa_mod_not_odd.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

w_rsa_public_exponent_not_in_range.en: RSA: Public exponent SHOULD be in the range between 2^16 + 1 and 2^256 - 1
w_rsa_public_exponent_not_in_range.zh: RSA 公钥指数应在 2^16+1 和 2^256-1 之间
w_rsa_public_exponent_not_in_range.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

w_server_cert_valid_time_longer_than_199.en: TLS server certificates issued on or after on or after March 15, 2026 00:00 GMT/UTC should not have a validity period greater than 199 days
w_server_cert_valid_time_longer_than_199.zh: 2026-03-15 起签发的 TLS 服务器证书有效期不应超过 199 天
w_server_cert_valid_time_longer_than_199.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

w_server_cert_valid_time_longer_than_46_.en: TLS server certificates issued on or after on or after March 15, 2029 00:00 GMT/UTC should not have a validity period greater than 46 days
w_server_cert_valid_time_longer_than_46_.zh: 2029-03-15 起签发的 TLS 服务器证书有效期不应超过 46 天
w_server_cert_valid_time_longer_than_46_.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

w_server_cert_valid_time_longer_than_99_.en: TLS server certificates issued on or after on or after March 15, 2027 00:00 GMT/UTC should not have a validity period greater than 99 days
w_server_cert_valid_time_longer_than_99_.zh: 2027-03-15 起签发的 TLS 服务器证书有效期不应超过 99 天
w_server_cert_valid_time_longer_than_99_.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

w_sub_ca_aia_does_not_contain_issuing_ca.en: Subordinate CA Certificate: authorityInformationAccess SHOULD also contain the HTTP URL of the Issuing CA's certificate.
w_sub_ca_aia_does_not_contain_issuing_ca.zh: 下级 CA 证书的 AIA 也应包含签发 CA 证书的 HTTP URL
w_sub_ca_aia_does_not_contain_issuing_ca.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

w_sub_ca_aia_missing.en: Subordinate CA Certificate: authorityInformationAccess SHOULD be present.
w_sub_ca_aia_missing.zh: 下级 CA 证书应包含 authorityInformationAccess 扩展
w_sub_ca_aia_missing.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

w_sub_ca_certificate_policies_marked_cri.en: Subordinate CA certificates certificatePolicies extension should not be marked as critical
