w_sub_ca_certificate_policies_marked_cri.zh: 下级 CA 证书的 certificatePolicies 扩展不应标记为 critical
w_sub_ca_certificate_policies_marked_cri.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

w_sub_ca_eku_critical.en: Subordinate CA certificate extkeyUsage extension should be marked non-critical if present
w_sub_ca_eku_critical.zh: 下级 CA 证书若含 extkeyUsage 扩展应标记为非 critical
w_sub_ca_eku_critical.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

w_sub_ca_name_constraints_not_critical.en: Subordinate CA Certificate: NameConstraints if present, SHOULD be marked critical.
w_sub_ca_name_constraints_not_critical.zh: 下级 CA 证书若含 NameConstraints 应标记为 critical
w_sub_ca_name_constraints_not_critical.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

w_sub_cert_aia_contains_internal_names.en: Subscriber certificates authorityInformationAccess extension should contain the HTTP URL of the issuing CA’s certificate, for public certificates this should not be an internal name
w_sub_cert_aia_contains_internal_names.zh: 订户证书的 AIA 应包含签发 CA 证书的 HTTP URL，公网证书不应为内部名称
w_sub_cert_aia_contains_internal_names.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

w_sub_cert_aia_does_not_contain_issuing_.en: Subscriber certificates authorityInformationAccess extension should contain the HTTP URL of the issuing CA’s certificate
w_sub_cert_aia_does_not_contain_issuing_.zh: 订户证书的 AIA 应包含签发 CA 证书的 HTTP URL
w_sub_cert_aia_does_not_contain_issuing_.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

w_sub_cert_certificate_policies_marked_c.en: Subscriber Certificate: certificatePolicies MUST be present and SHOULD NOT be marked critical.
w_sub_cert_certificate_policies_marked_c.zh: 订户证书的 certificatePolicies 必须存在且不应标记为 critical
w_sub_cert_certificate_policies_marked_c.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

w_sub_cert_eku_extra_values.en: Subscriber Certificate: extKeyUsage values other than id-kp-serverAuth, id-kp-clientAuth, and id-kp-emailProtection SHOULD NOT be present.
w_sub_cert_eku_extra_values.zh: 订户证书 extKeyUsage 不应包含 id-kp-serverAuth、id-kp-clientAuth、id-kp-emailProtection 之外的值
w_sub_cert_eku_extra_values.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

w_sub_cert_sha1_expiration_too_long.en: Subscriber certificates using the SHA-1 algorithm SHOULD NOT have an expiration date later than 1 Jan 2017
w_sub_cert_sha1_expiration_too_long.zh: 使用 SHA-1 的订户证书有效期不应晚于 2017-01-01
w_sub_cert_sha1_expiration_too_long.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

w_subject_common_name_included.en: Subscriber Certificate: commonName is NOT RECOMMENDED.
w_subject_common_name_included.zh: 订户证书的 commonName 不推荐使用
w_subject_common_name_included.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

w_subject_contains_malformed_arpa_ip.en: Checks no subject domain name contains a rDNS entry in the
w_subject_contains_malformed_arpa_ip.zh: 检查 subject 域名是否包含 .arpa 反向解析区中的格式错误条目
w_subject_contains_malformed_arpa_ip.source: CA/B Forum 基线要求（TLS 服务器证书）

e_cabf_org_identifier_joic_mismatch.en: The cabfOrganizationIdentifier field country mismatches the JOI country in the subject DN
e_cabf_org_identifier_joic_mismatch.zh: cabfOrganizationIdentifier 字段的国家代码与 subject DN 中 JOI（法人/个人标识符）的国家不一致
e_cabf_org_identifier_joic_mismatch.source: CA/B Forum 扩展验证（EV）证书指南

e_cabf_org_identifier_psd_vat_has_state.en: The cabfOrganizationIdentifier field for PSD org VAT Registration Schemes cannot include the referenceStateOrProvince field.
e_cabf_org_identifier_psd_vat_has_state.zh: PSD 组织增值税登记方案的 cabfOrganizationIdentifier 字段不得包含 referenceStateOrProvince
e_cabf_org_identifier_psd_vat_has_state.source: CA/B Forum 扩展验证（EV）证书指南

e_ev_business_category_missing.en: EV certificates must include businessCategory in subject
e_ev_business_category_missing.zh: EV 证书 subject 必须包含 businessCategory（业务类别）
e_ev_business_category_missing.source: CA/B Forum 扩展验证（EV）证书指南

e_ev_country_name_missing.en: EV certificates must include countryName in subject
e_ev_country_name_missing.zh: EV 证书 subject 必须包含 countryName（国家）
e_ev_country_name_missing.source: CA/B Forum 扩展验证（EV）证书指南

e_ev_extra_subject_attribs.en: CAs SHALL NOT include any Subject Distinguished Name attributes except as specified...
e_ev_extra_subject_attribs.zh: EV 证书不得包含指南规定之外的任何 Subject DN 属性
e_ev_extra_subject_attribs.source: CA/B Forum 扩展验证（EV）证书指南

e_ev_invalid_business_category.en: Checks that businessCategory contains a valid value as per EV Guidelines 7.1.4.2.3
e_ev_invalid_business_category.zh: businessCategory 必须为 EV 指南 7.1.4.2.3 规定的有效值
e_ev_invalid_business_category.source: CA/B Forum 扩展验证（EV）证书指南

e_ev_invalid_orgid_reg_scheme.en: The Registration Schemes allowed in organizationIdentifier are those listed in Appendix H
e_ev_invalid_orgid_reg_scheme.zh: organizationIdentifier 中允许的注册方案限于附录 H 所列
e_ev_invalid_orgid_reg_scheme.source: CA/B Forum 扩展验证（EV）证书指南

e_ev_not_wildcard.en: Wildcard certificates are not allowed for EV Certificates except for those with .onion as the TLD.
e_ev_not_wildcard.zh: EV 证书不允许使用通配符证书，除非 TLD 为 .onion
e_ev_not_wildcard.source: CA/B Forum 扩展验证（EV）证书指南

e_ev_organization_id_missing.en: Effective January 31, 2020, if the subject:organizationIdentifier field is
e_ev_organization_id_missing.zh: 2020-01-31 起 EV 证书必须包含 subject:organizationIdentifier 字段
e_ev_organization_id_missing.source: CA/B Forum 扩展验证（EV）证书指南

e_ev_organization_name_missing.en: EV certificates must include organizationName in subject
e_ev_organization_name_missing.zh: EV 证书 subject 必须包含 organizationName（组织名）
e_ev_organization_name_missing.source: CA/B Forum 扩展验证（EV）证书指南

e_ev_orgid_inconsistent_subj_and_ext.en: Checks that the organizationIdentifier Subject attribute and the CABFOrganizationIdentifier extension are consistent
e_ev_orgid_inconsistent_subj_and_ext.zh: subject 的 organizationIdentifier 属性与 CABFOrganizationIdentifier 扩展必须一致
e_ev_orgid_inconsistent_subj_and_ext.source: CA/B Forum 扩展验证（EV）证书指南

e_ev_san_ip_address_present.en: The Subject Alternate Name extension MUST contain only 'dnsName' name types.
e_ev_san_ip_address_present.zh: EV 证书 SAN 扩展只允许包含 dnsName 名称类型（不允许 IP 地址）
e_ev_san_ip_address_present.source: CA/B Forum 扩展验证（EV）证书指南

e_ev_serial_number_missing.en: EV certificates must include serialNumber in subject
e_ev_serial_number_missing.zh: EV 证书 subject 必须包含 serialNumber（主体序列号）
e_ev_serial_number_missing.source: CA/B Forum 扩展验证（EV）证书指南

e_ev_valid_time_too_long.en: EV certificates must be 27 months in validity or less
e_ev_valid_time_too_long.zh: EV 证书有效期不得超过 27 个月
e_ev_valid_time_too_long.source: CA/B Forum 扩展验证（EV）证书指南

e_onion_subject_validity_time_too_large.zh: .onion 主体证书的有效期不得超过 EV 指南规定的限制
e_onion_subject_validity_time_too_large.source: CA/B Forum 扩展验证（EV）证书指南

e_cs_aia_missing_ca_issuers_http_url.en: The authorityInformationAccess extension MUST contain the HTTP URL of the Issuing CA's certificate (id-ad-caIssuers).
e_cs_aia_missing_ca_issuers_http_url.zh: 代码签名证书的 AIA 扩展必须包含签发 CA 证书的 HTTP URL（id-ad-caIssuers）
e_cs_aia_missing_ca_issuers_http_url.source: CA/B Forum 代码签名基线要求

e_cs_aia_ocsp_not_http.en: If the CA provides OCSP responses, the authorityInformationAccess extension MUST contain the HTTP URL of the Issuing CA's OCSP responder (id-ad-ocsp).
e_cs_aia_ocsp_not_http.zh: 若 CA 提供 OCSP 响应，代码签名证书 AIA 必须包含签发 CA 的 OCSP 响应器 HTTP URL（id-ad-ocsp）
e_cs_aia_ocsp_not_http.source: CA/B Forum 代码签名基线要求

e_cs_authority_information_access.en: The authorityInformationAccess extension MUST be present and MUST NOT be marked critical.
e_cs_authority_information_access.zh: 代码签名证书必须包含 AIA 扩展且不得标记为 critical
e_cs_authority_information_access.source: CA/B Forum 代码签名基线要求

e_cs_crl_distribution_points.en: This extension MUST be present. It MUST NOT be marked critical. It MUST contain the HTTP URL of the CA's CRL service
e_cs_crl_distribution_points.zh: 代码签名证书必须包含 CDP 扩展，不得标记 critical，且必须含 CA 的 CRL 服务的 HTTP URL
e_cs_crl_distribution_points.source: CA/B Forum 代码签名基线要求

e_cs_ecdsa_prohibited_curve.en: If the Key is ECDSA, then the curve MUST be one of NIST P-256, P-384, or P-521
e_cs_ecdsa_prohibited_curve.zh: 代码签名证书若为 ECDSA 密钥，曲线必须是 NIST P-256、P-384 或 P-521
e_cs_ecdsa_prohibited_curve.source: CA/B Forum 代码签名基线要求

e_cs_eku_required.en: If the Certificate is a Code Signing Certificate, then id-kp-codeSigning MUST be present. anyExtendedKeyUsage and id-kp-serverAuth MUST NOT be present.
e_cs_eku_required.zh: 代码签名证书必须含 id-kp-codeSigning EKU，不得含 anyExtendedKeyUsage 和 id-kp-serverAuth
e_cs_eku_required.source: CA/B Forum 代码签名基线要求

e_cs_key_usage_required.en: This extension MUST be present and MUST be marked critical. The bit position for digitalSignature MUST be set. The bit positions for keyCertSign and cRLSign MUST NOT be set. All other bit positions SHOULD NOT be set.
e_cs_key_usage_required.zh: 代码签名证书 KeyUsage 必须存在且 critical，必须设置 digitalSignature，不得设置 keyCertSign 和 cRLSign
e_cs_key_usage_required.source: CA/B Forum 代码签名基线要求

e_cs_max_validity_period_39_months.en: Code Signing certificate validity must not exceed 39 months for certificates issued before March 1st, 2026
e_cs_max_validity_period_39_months.zh: 2026-03-01 前签发的代码签名证书有效期不得超过 39 个月
e_cs_max_validity_period_39_months.source: CA/B Forum 代码签名基线要求

e_cs_max_validity_period_460_days.en: Code Signing certificate validity must not exceed 460 days for certificates issued on or after March 1st, 2026
e_cs_max_validity_period_460_days.zh: 2026-03-01 起签发的代码签名证书有效期不得超过 460 天
e_cs_max_validity_period_460_days.source: CA/B Forum 代码签名基线要求

e_cs_requires_org.en: Code Signing certificates MUST include organizationName in the subject field
e_cs_requires_org.zh: 代码签名证书 subject 必须包含 organizationName（组织名）
e_cs_requires_org.source: CA/B Forum 代码签名基线要求

e_cs_rsa_key_size.en: If the Key is RSA, then the modulus MUST be at least 3072 bits in length
e_cs_rsa_key_size.zh: 代码签名证书若为 RSA 密钥，模数必须至少 3072 位
e_cs_rsa_key_size.source: CA/B Forum 代码签名基线要求

e_cs_signature_algorithm_not_supported.en: Certificates MUST meet the following requirements for algorithm Source: SHA-1*, SHA-256, SHA-384, SHA-512
e_cs_signature_algorithm_not_supported.zh: 代码签名证书签名算法必须为 SHA-256、SHA-384、SHA-512（及限定的 SHA-1）
e_cs_signature_algorithm_not_supported.source: CA/B Forum 代码签名基线要求

e_cs_subject_country_name.en: The subject:countryName MUST contain the two-letter ISO 3166-1 country code associated with the location of the Subject verified under BR Section 3.2.2.3.
e_cs_subject_country_name.zh: 代码签名证书 subject:countryName 必须为与主体所在地对应的两位 ISO 3166-1 国家代码
e_cs_subject_country_name.source: CA/B Forum 代码签名基线要求

e_cs_subject_locality_or_province_requir.en: Non-EV Code Signing Certificate: at least one of subject:localityName or subject:stateOrProvinceName must be present.
e_cs_subject_locality_or_province_requir.zh: 非 EV 代码签名证书至少包含 subject:localityName 或 subject:stateOrProvinceName 之一
e_cs_subject_locality_or_province_requir.source: CA/B Forum 代码签名基线要求

e_cs_subject_prohibited.en: The subject:domainComponent MUST not be present in a Code Signing Certificate.
e_cs_subject_prohibited.zh: 代码签名证书 subject 中不得包含 domainComponent
e_cs_subject_prohibited.source: CA/B Forum 代码签名基线要求

e_adobe_extensions_legacy_multipurpose_c.en: If present, Adobe Time‐stamp X509 extension (1.2.840.113583.1.1.9.1) or the Adobe ArchiveRevInfo extension (1.2.840.113583.1.1.9.2) SHALL NOT be marked as critical for multipurpose/legacy SMIME certificates
e_adobe_extensions_legacy_multipurpose_c.zh: Legacy/Multipurpose S/MIME 证书中的 Adobe 时间戳扩展或 ArchiveRevInfo 扩展不得标记为 critical
e_adobe_extensions_legacy_multipurpose_c.source: CA/B Forum S/MIME 邮件证书基线要求

e_adobe_extensions_strict_presence.en: Adobe Time‐stamp X509 extension (1.2.840.113583.1.1.9.1) and the Adobe ArchiveRevInfo extension (1.2.840.113583.1.1.9.2) are prohibited for strict SMIME certificates
e_adobe_extensions_strict_presence.zh: Strict S/MIME 证书禁止包含 Adobe 时间戳扩展和 ArchiveRevInfo 扩展
e_adobe_extensions_strict_presence.source: CA/B Forum S/MIME 邮件证书基线要求

e_authority_key_identifier_correct.en: authorityKeyIdentifier SHALL be present. This extension SHALL NOT be marked critical. The keyIdentifier field SHALL be present. authorityCertIssuer and authorityCertSerialNumber fields SHALL NOT be present.
e_authority_key_identifier_correct.zh: S/MIME 证书必须包含 AKI 扩展，不得 critical，必须含 keyIdentifier，不得含 authorityCertIssuer 和 authorityCertSerialNumber
e_authority_key_identifier_correct.source: CA/B Forum S/MIME 邮件证书基线要求

e_commonname_mailbox_validated.en: If present, the commonName attribute of a mailbox-validated certificate SHALL contain a mailbox address
e_commonname_mailbox_validated.zh: 邮箱验证的 S/MIME 证书若含 commonName，其值必须为邮箱地址
e_commonname_mailbox_validated.source: CA/B Forum S/MIME 邮件证书基线要求

e_ec_other_key_usages.en: Other bit positions SHALL NOT be set.
e_ec_other_key_usages.zh: S/MIME 证书 KeyUsage 的其他位不得设置
e_ec_other_key_usages.source: CA/B Forum S/MIME 邮件证书基线要求

e_ecpublickey_key_usages.en: For signing only, bit positions SHALL be set for digitalSignature and MAY be set for nonRepudiation. For key management only, bit positions SHALL be set for keyEncipherment.For dual use, bit positions SHALL be set for digitalSignature and keyEncipherment and MAY be set for nonRepudiation.
e_ecpublickey_key_usages.zh: EC 公钥 S/MIME 证书：签名用途须设 digitalSignature（可设 nonRepudiation），密钥管理须设 keyEncipherment，双重用途须设 digitalSignature+keyEncipherment
e_ecpublickey_key_usages.source: CA/B Forum S/MIME 邮件证书基线要求

e_edwardspublickey_key_usages.en: Bit positions SHALL be set for digitalSignature and MAY be set for nonRepudiation.
e_edwardspublickey_key_usages.zh: Edwards 公钥 S/MIME 证书须设置 digitalSignature，可设置 nonRepudiation
e_edwardspublickey_key_usages.source: CA/B Forum S/MIME 邮件证书基线要求

e_exactly_one_smime_policy.en: The subscriber cert SHALL include exactly one of the reserved policy OIDs in §7.1.6.1
e_exactly_one_smime_policy.zh: S/MIME 订户证书必须且只能包含 7.1.6.1 节中的一个保留策略 OID
e_exactly_one_smime_policy.source: CA/B Forum S/MIME 邮件证书基线要求

e_invalid_individual_identity.en: Non-legacy IV and SV certificates... SHALL include either subject:givenName and/or subject:surname, or the subject:pseudonym.
e_invalid_individual_identity.zh: 非 Legacy 的 IV/SV S/MIME 证书必须包含 givenName 和/或 surname，或 pseudonym
e_invalid_individual_identity.source: CA/B Forum S/MIME 邮件证书基线要求

e_invalid_legacy_spki_algoid.zh: 检查 SubjectPublicKeyInfo 的算法标识符是否在允许范围内（Legacy 模式）
e_invalid_legacy_spki_algoid.source: CA/B Forum S/MIME 邮件证书基线要求

e_invalid_spki_algoid.en: Checks that SubjectPublicKeyInfo.AlgorithmIdentifier is allowed, including PQC algorithms.
e_invalid_spki_algoid.zh: 检查 SubjectPublicKeyInfo 的算法标识符是否在允许范围内（含 PQC 后量子算法）
e_invalid_spki_algoid.source: CA/B Forum S/MIME 邮件证书基线要求

e_key_usage_presence.zh: S/MIME 证书必须包含 keyUsage 扩展
e_key_usage_presence.source: CA/B Forum S/MIME 邮件证书基线要求

e_legacy_generation_deprecated.en: S/MIME Subscriber Certificates SHALL NOT be issued using the Legacy Generation profiles
e_legacy_generation_deprecated.zh: S/MIME 订户证书不得使用已废弃的 Legacy Generation 配置文件签发
e_legacy_generation_deprecated.source: CA/B Forum S/MIME 邮件证书基线要求

e_legal_entity_identifier.en: Mailbox/individual: prohibited. Organization/sponsor: may be present
e_legal_entity_identifier.zh: S/MIME 证书中 Mailbox/Individual 类型禁止、Organization/Sponsor 类型允许包含法律实体标识符
e_legal_entity_identifier.source: CA/B Forum S/MIME 邮件证书基线要求

e_mailbox_validated_allowed_subjectdn_at.en: Only certain Subject DN attributes are permitted to be present in mailbox-validated certificates.
e_mailbox_validated_allowed_subjectdn_at.zh: 邮箱验证证书只允许包含规定的 Subject DN 属性
e_mailbox_validated_allowed_subjectdn_at.source: CA/B Forum S/MIME 邮件证书基线要求

e_mailbox_validated_enforce_subject_fiel.en: SMIME certificates complying to mailbox validated profiles MAY only contain commonName, serialNumber or emailAddress attributes in the Subject DN
e_mailbox_validated_enforce_subject_fiel.zh: 邮箱验证配置文件的 S/MIME 证书 Subject DN 只允许 commonName、serialNumber 或 emailAddress 属性
e_mailbox_validated_enforce_subject_fiel.source: CA/B Forum S/MIME 邮件证书基线要求

e_org_validated_invalid_cn.en: In OV S/MIME certs, the Subject CN must either contain an email address or match organizatioName
e_org_validated_invalid_cn.zh: OV S/MIME 证书的 CN 必须为邮箱地址或与组织名一致
e_org_validated_invalid_cn.source: CA/B Forum S/MIME 邮件证书基线要求

e_registration_scheme_id_matches_subject.en: The country code used in the Registration Scheme identifier SHALL match that of the subject:countryName in the Certificate as specified in Section 7.1.4.2.2
e_registration_scheme_id_matches_subject.zh: 注册方案标识符中的国家代码必须与证书 subject:countryName 一致
e_registration_scheme_id_matches_subject.source: CA/B Forum S/MIME 邮件证书基线要求

e_rsa_key_usage_legacy_multipurpose.en: For signing only, bit positions SHALL be set for digitalSignature and MAY be set for nonRepudiation. For key management only, bit positions SHALL be set for keyEncipherment and MAY be set for dataEncipherment. For dual use, bit positions SHALL be set for digitalSignature and keyEncipherment and MAY be set for nonRepudiation and dataEncipherment.
e_rsa_key_usage_legacy_multipurpose.zh: RSA S/MIME（Legacy/Multipurpose）KeyUsage：签名须设 digitalSignature（可 nonRepudiation），密钥管理须设 keyEncipherment（可 dataEncipherment）
e_rsa_key_usage_legacy_multipurpose.source: CA/B Forum S/MIME 邮件证书基线要求

e_rsa_key_usage_strict.en: For signing only, bit positions SHALL be set for digitalSignature and MAY be set for nonRepudiation. For key management only, bit positions SHALL be set for keyEncipherment. For dual use, bit positions SHALL be set for digitalSignature and keyEncipherment and MAY be set for nonRepudiation.
e_rsa_key_usage_strict.zh: RSA S/MIME（Strict）KeyUsage：签名须设 digitalSignature（可 nonRepudiation），密钥管理只可设 keyEncipherment
e_rsa_key_usage_strict.source: CA/B Forum S/MIME 邮件证书基线要求

e_rsa_other_key_usages.en: Other bit positions SHALL NOT be set.
e_rsa_other_key_usages.zh: S/MIME 证书 KeyUsage 的其他位不得设置
e_rsa_other_key_usages.source: CA/B Forum S/MIME 邮件证书基线要求

e_san_shall_be_present.en: Subject alternative name SHALL be present
e_san_shall_be_present.zh: S/MIME 证书必须包含 SAN（主题备用名称）扩展
e_san_shall_be_present.source: CA/B Forum S/MIME 邮件证书基线要求

e_single_email_if_present.en: If present, the subject:emailAddress SHALL contain a single Mailbox Address. All Mailbox Addresses in the subject field SHALL be repeated as rfc822Name or otherName values of type id-on-SmtpUTF8Mailbox in SAN extension.
e_single_email_if_present.zh: subject:emailAddress 若存在必须为单一邮箱地址，且 subject 中所有邮箱地址都必须在 SAN 中重复为 rfc822Name 或 SmtpUTF8Mailbox 类型
e_single_email_if_present.source: CA/B Forum S/MIME 邮件证书基线要求

e_single_email_subject_if_present.en: If present, the subject:emailAddress SHALL contain a single Mailbox Address
e_single_email_subject_if_present.zh: subject:emailAddress 若存在必须为单一邮箱地址
e_single_email_subject_if_present.source: CA/B Forum S/MIME 邮件证书基线要求

e_smime_legacy_aia_shall_have_one_http.en: SMIME Legacy certificates authorityInformationAccess When provided, at least one accessMethod SHALL have the URI scheme HTTP. Other schemes (LDAP, FTP, ...) MAY be present.
e_smime_legacy_aia_shall_have_one_http.zh: Legacy S/MIME 证书 AIA 若提供，至少一个访问方法必须为 HTTP 协议
e_smime_legacy_aia_shall_have_one_http.source: CA/B Forum S/MIME 邮件证书基线要求

e_smime_legacy_multipurpose_eku_check.en: Strict/Multipurpose and Legacy: id-kp-emailProtection SHALL be present. Other values MAY be present.  The values id-kp-serverAuth, id-kp-codeSigning, id-kp-timeStamping, and anyExtendedKeyUsage values SHALL NOT be present.
e_smime_legacy_multipurpose_eku_check.zh: Strict/Multipurpose/Legacy S/MIME 必须含 id-kp-emailProtection EKU，不得含 serverAuth、codeSigning、timeStamping 和 anyExtendedKeyUsage
e_smime_legacy_multipurpose_eku_check.source: CA/B Forum S/MIME 邮件证书基线要求

e_smime_qc_statements_must_not_be_critic.en: This extension MAY be present and SHALL NOT be marked critical.
e_smime_qc_statements_must_not_be_critic.zh: S/MIME 证书的 qcStatements 扩展可以存在但不得标记为 critical
e_smime_qc_statements_must_not_be_critic.source: CA/B Forum S/MIME 邮件证书基线要求

e_smime_strict_aia_shall_have_http_only.en: SMIME Strict certificates authorityInformationAccess. When provided, every accessMethod SHALL have the URI scheme HTTP. Other schemes SHALL NOT be present.
e_smime_strict_aia_shall_have_http_only.zh: Strict S/MIME 证书 AIA 若提供，所有访问方法的协议必须为 HTTP
e_smime_strict_aia_shall_have_http_only.source: CA/B Forum S/MIME 邮件证书基线要求

e_smime_strict_eku_check.en: Strict: id-kp-emailProtection SHALL be present.  Other values SHALL NOT be present
e_smime_strict_eku_check.zh: Strict S/MIME 证书必须含 id-kp-emailProtection EKU，不得含其他值
e_smime_strict_eku_check.source: CA/B Forum S/MIME 邮件证书基线要求

e_strict_multipurpose_smime_ext_subject_.en: SMIME Strict and Multipurpose certificates cannot have Subject Directory Attributes
e_strict_multipurpose_smime_ext_subject_.zh: Strict/Multipurpose S/MIME 证书不得包含 Subject Directory Attributes 扩展
e_strict_multipurpose_smime_ext_subject_.source: CA/B Forum S/MIME 邮件证书基线要求

e_subject_country_name.en: If present, the subject:countryName SHALL contain the two‐letter ISO 3166‐1 country code associated with the location of the Subject
e_subject_country_name.zh: S/MIME 证书 subject:countryName 若存在必须为与主体所在地对应的两位 ISO 3166-1 国家代码
e_subject_country_name.source: CA/B Forum S/MIME 邮件证书基线要求

e_subscribers_crl_distribution_points_ar.en: cRLDistributionPoints SHALL have URI scheme HTTP.
e_subscribers_crl_distribution_points_ar.zh: S/MIME 证书 cRLDistributionPoints 的协议必须为 HTTP
e_subscribers_crl_distribution_points_ar.source: CA/B Forum S/MIME 邮件证书基线要求

e_subscribers_shall_have_crl_distributio.zh: S/MIME 证书必须包含 cRLDistributionPoints 扩展
e_subscribers_shall_have_crl_distributio.source: CA/B Forum S/MIME 邮件证书基线要求

w_key_usage_criticality.en: keyUsage... This extension SHOULD be marked critical
w_key_usage_criticality.zh: S/MIME 证书的 keyUsage 扩展应标记为 critical
w_key_usage_criticality.source: CA/B Forum S/MIME 邮件证书基线要求

w_san_should_not_be_critical.en: subjectAlternativeName SHOULD NOT be marked critical unless the subject field is an empty sequence.
w_san_should_not_be_critical.zh: subjectAlternativeName 不应标记为 critical，除非 subject 为空序列
w_san_should_not_be_critical.source: CA/B Forum S/MIME 邮件证书基线要求

w_smime_aia_contains_internal_names.en: SMIME certificates authorityInformationAccess. Internal domain names should not be included.
w_smime_aia_contains_internal_names.zh: S/MIME 证书 AIA 不应包含内部域名
w_smime_aia_contains_internal_names.source: CA/B Forum S/MIME 邮件证书基线要求

e_tls_server_cert_valid_time_longer_than.en: TLS server certificates issued on or after September 1, 2020
e_tls_server_cert_valid_time_longer_than.zh: 2020-09-01 起签发的 TLS 服务器证书有效期不得超过 398 天（Apple 策略）

w_ct_sct_policy_count_unsatisfied.en: Check if certificate has enough embedded SCTs to meet Apple CT Policy
w_ct_sct_policy_count_unsatisfied.zh: 检查证书内嵌的 SCT（证书透明日志证明）数量是否满足 Apple CT 策略

w_tls_server_cert_valid_time_longer_than.en: TLS server certificates issued on or after September 1, 2020
w_tls_server_cert_valid_time_longer_than.zh: 2020-09-01 起签发的 TLS 服务器证书有效期不应超过 397 天（Apple 策略，警告）

e_mp_authority_key_identifier_correct.en: CAs MUST NOT issue certificates that have authority key IDs that include both the key ID and the issuer's issuer name and serial number
e_mp_authority_key_identifier_correct.zh: CA 不得签发 AKI 同时包含密钥 ID 与签发者名称和序列号的证书（Mozilla 策略）

e_mp_ecdsa_pub_key_encoding_correct.en: The encoded algorithm identifiers for ECDSA public keys MUST match specific bytes
e_mp_ecdsa_pub_key_encoding_correct.zh: ECDSA 公钥的算法标识符编码必须匹配特定字节（Mozilla 策略）

e_mp_ecdsa_signature_encoding_correct.en: The encoded algorithm identifiers for ECDSA signatures MUST match specific hex-encoded bytes
e_mp_ecdsa_signature_encoding_correct.zh: ECDSA 签名的算法标识符编码必须匹配特定十六进制字节（Mozilla 策略）

e_mp_exponent_cannot_be_one.en: CAs MUST NOT issue certificates that have invalid public keys (e.g., RSA certificates with public exponent equal to 1)
e_mp_exponent_cannot_be_one.zh: CA 不得签发公钥无效的证书（如 RSA 公钥指数为 1）

e_mp_modulus_must_be_2048_bits_or_more.en: RSA keys must have modulus size of at least 2048 bits
e_mp_modulus_must_be_2048_bits_or_more.zh: RSA 密钥模数必须至少为 2048 位（Mozilla 策略）

e_mp_modulus_must_be_divisible_by_8.en: RSA keys must have a modulus size divisible by 8
e_mp_modulus_must_be_divisible_by_8.zh: RSA 密钥模数大小必须能被 8 整除（Mozilla 策略）

e_mp_rsassa-pss_in_spki.en: CAs MUST NOT use the id-RSASSA-PSS OID (1.2.840.113549.1.1.10) within a SubjectPublicKeyInfo to represent a RSA key.
e_mp_rsassa-pss_in_spki.zh: SubjectPublicKeyInfo 中不得使用 id-RSASSA-PSS OID 表示 RSA 密钥

e_mp_rsassa-pss_parameters_encoding_in_s.en: The encoded AlgorithmIdentifier for RSASSA-PSS in the signature algorithm MUST match specific bytes
e_mp_rsassa-pss_parameters_encoding_in_s.zh: 签名算法中 RSASSA-PSS 的算法标识符编码必须匹配特定字节

e_prohibit_dsa_usage.en: DSA is not an explicitly allowed signature algorithm, therefore it is forbidden.
e_prohibit_dsa_usage.zh: DSA 不是明确允许的签名算法，因此禁止使用

n_mp_allowed_eku.en: A SubCA certificate must not have key usage that allows for both server auth and email protection, and must not use anyExtendedKeyUsage
n_mp_allowed_eku.zh: 下级 CA 证书的密钥用途不得同时允许服务器认证和邮件保护，且不得使用 anyExtendedKeyUsage（提示）

e_client_auth_not_allowed.en: Checks that Server certs do not contain clientAuth in the EKU extension
e_client_auth_not_allowed.zh: 服务器证书的 EKU 扩展中不得包含 clientAuth（Chrome 策略）

e_crl_no_duplicate_extensions.en: The CRL must not include duplicate extensions.
e_crl_no_duplicate_extensions.zh: CRL 不得包含重复的扩展

e_crl_revocation_date_too_early.en: The revocation time of each revoked certificate should not before the publication date of RFC 2459.
e_crl_revocation_date_too_early.zh: 每个已吊销证书的吊销时间不得早于 RFC 2459 的发布日期

e_crl_revoked_certificate_crl_entry_has_.en: The revoked certificate in the CRL must not have duplicate extensions.
e_crl_revoked_certificate_crl_entry_has_.zh: CRL 中被吊销证书条目不得包含重复的扩展

e_crl_unique_revoked_certificate.en: The CRL must not include duplicate serial numbers in its revoked certificates list.
e_crl_unique_revoked_certificate.zh: CRL 的吊销证书列表中不得出现重复的序列号

e_ian_bare_wildcard.en: A wildcard MUST be accompanied by other data to its right (Only checks IANDNSNames)
e_ian_bare_wildcard.zh: 通配符右侧必须有其他数据（仅检查 IAN 的 DNS 名称）

e_ian_dns_name_includes_null_char.en: DNSName MUST NOT include a null character
e_ian_dns_name_includes_null_char.zh: DNS 名称不得包含空字符

e_ian_dns_name_starts_with_period.en: DNSName MUST NOT start with a period
e_ian_dns_name_starts_with_period.zh: DNS 名称不得以句点开头

e_ian_wildcard_not_first.en: A wildcard MUST be in the first label of FQDN (ie not: www.*.com) (Only checks IANDNSNames)
e_ian_wildcard_not_first.zh: 通配符必须位于 FQDN 的第一个标签（不允许 www.*.com）（仅检查 IAN）

e_rsa_exp_negative.en: RSA public key exponent MUST be positive
e_rsa_exp_negative.zh: RSA 公钥指数必须为正数

e_rsa_fermat_factorization.en: RSA key pairs that are too close to each other are susceptible to the Fermat Factorization
e_rsa_fermat_factorization.zh: RSA 密钥对的素数过于接近易受费马分解攻击

e_rsa_no_public_key.en: The RSA public key should be present

e_san_bare_wildcard.en: A wildcard MUST be accompanied by other data to its right (Only checks DNSName)
e_san_bare_wildcard.zh: 通配符右侧必须有其他数据（仅检查 SAN 的 DNS 名称）

e_san_dns_name_includes_null_char.en: DNSName MUST NOT include a null character
e_san_dns_name_includes_null_char.zh: DNS 名称不得包含空字符

e_san_dns_name_starts_with_period.en: DNSName MUST NOT start with a period
e_san_dns_name_starts_with_period.zh: DNS 名称不得以句点开头

e_san_wildcard_not_first.en: A wildcard MUST be in the first label of FQDN (ie not: www.*.com) (Only checks DNSName)
e_san_wildcard_not_first.zh: 通配符必须位于 FQDN 的第一个标签（不允许 www.*.com）（仅检查 SAN）

e_subj_contains_html_entities.en: Detects the presence of HTML entities (e.g. '&') in the Subject, which probably shouldn't be there
e_subj_contains_html_entities.zh: 检测 subject 中是否包含 HTML 实体（如 &），这些通常不应存在

e_subj_country_not_uppercase.en: Alpha-2 country codes shall consist of LATIN CAPITAL LETTER A through LATIN CAPITAL LETTER Z
e_subj_country_not_uppercase.zh: 两位国家代码必须为大写拉丁字母

e_utf8_latin1_mixup.en: Checks for wrongly encoded diacritics due to UTF-8 mistaken for Latin-1
e_utf8_latin1_mixup.zh: 检测因将 UTF-8 误当作 Latin-1 导致的变音符号错误编码

e_utf8_replacement_char_in_subject.en: Detects the UTF8 Replacement Character anywhere in the Subject field
e_utf8_replacement_char_in_subject.zh: 检测 subject 字段中是否包含 UTF-8 替换字符（U+FFFD）

e_validity_time_not_positive.en: Certificates MUST have a positive time for which they are valid
e_validity_time_not_positive.zh: 证书的有效时间必须为正（有效期长度大于 0）

n_contains_redacted_dnsname.en: Some precerts are redacted and of the form ?.?.a.com or *.?.a.com
n_contains_redacted_dnsname.zh: 部分预证书被编辑，形式为 ?.?.a.com 或 *.?.a.com（提示信息）

n_multiple_subject_rdn.en: Certificates typically do not have multiple attributes in a single RDN (subject). This may be an error.
n_multiple_subject_rdn.zh: 证书通常在单个 RDN 中不含多个属性，这可能是错误（提示）

n_san_dns_name_duplicate.zh: SAN 的 DNS 名称包含重复值（提示）

n_san_iana_pub_suffix_empty.en: The domain SHOULD NOT have a bare public suffix
n_san_iana_pub_suffix_empty.zh: 域名不应为裸的公共后缀（提示）

w_ian_iana_pub_suffix_empty.en: Domain SHOULD NOT have a bare public suffix
w_ian_iana_pub_suffix_empty.zh: 域名不应为裸的公共后缀（IAN，警告）

w_issuer_dn_leading_whitespace.en: AttributeValue in issuer RelativeDistinguishedName sequence SHOULD NOT have leading whitespace
w_issuer_dn_leading_whitespace.zh: issuer 的 RDN 属性值不应有前导空白

w_issuer_dn_trailing_whitespace.en: AttributeValue in issuer RelativeDistinguishedName sequence SHOULD NOT have trailing whitespace
w_issuer_dn_trailing_whitespace.zh: issuer 的 RDN 属性值不应有尾随空白

w_multiple_issuer_rdn.en: Certificates should not have multiple attributes in a single RDN (issuer)
w_multiple_issuer_rdn.zh: 证书 issuer 不应在单个 RDN 中有多个属性

w_subject_dn_leading_whitespace.en: AttributeValue in subject RelativeDistinguishedName sequence SHOULD NOT have leading whitespace
w_subject_dn_leading_whitespace.zh: subject 的 RDN 属性值不应有前导空白

w_subject_dn_trailing_whitespace.en: AttributeValue in subject RelativeDistinguishedName sequence SHOULD NOT have trailing whitespace
w_subject_dn_trailing_whitespace.zh: subject 的 RDN 属性值不应有尾随空白

e_duplicate_etsi_qcstatement.en: Checks for any duplicated ETSI QcStatements
e_duplicate_etsi_qcstatement.zh: 检查是否存在重复的 ETSI QcStatement
e_duplicate_etsi_qcstatement.source: ETSI 欧洲电子签名/合格证书（QC）

e_etsi_natural_person_key_usage_correct_.en: The key usage extension shall contain a valid key usage setting for ETSI certificates issued to natural persons
e_etsi_natural_person_key_usage_correct_.zh: 签发给自然人的 ETSI 证书，keyUsage 扩展必须包含有效的密钥用途设置
e_etsi_natural_person_key_usage_correct_.source: ETSI 欧洲电子签名/合格证书（QC）

e_etsi_natural_person_key_usage_mandator.en: The key usage extension shall be present for ETSI certificates issued to natural persons
e_etsi_natural_person_key_usage_mandator.zh: 签发给自然人的 ETSI 证书必须包含 keyUsage 扩展
e_etsi_natural_person_key_usage_mandator.source: ETSI 欧洲电子签名/合格证书（QC）

e_qcstatem_etsi_present_qcs_critical.en: Checks that a QC Statement which contains any of the id-etsi-qcs-... QC Statements is not marked critical
e_qcstatem_etsi_present_qcs_critical.zh: 含 id-etsi-qcs-... QC 语句的 QC Statement 不得标记为 critical
e_qcstatem_etsi_present_qcs_critical.source: ETSI 欧洲电子签名/合格证书（QC）

e_qcstatem_etsi_type_as_statem.en: Checks for erroneous QC Statement OID that actually are represented by ETSI ESI QC type OID.
e_qcstatem_etsi_type_as_statem.zh: 检查是否误将 ETSI ESI QC 类型 OID 用作 QC 语句 OID
e_qcstatem_etsi_type_as_statem.source: ETSI 欧洲电子签名/合格证书（QC）

e_qcstatem_mandatory_etsi_statems.en: Checks that a QC Statement that contains at least one of the ETSI ESI statements, also features the set of mandatory ETSI ESI QC statements.
e_qcstatem_mandatory_etsi_statems.zh: 含至少一个 ETSI ESI 语句的 QC Statement 还必须包含 ETSI ESI 强制要求的 QC 语句集
e_qcstatem_mandatory_etsi_statems.source: ETSI 欧洲电子签名/合格证书（QC）

e_qcstatem_pds_must_have_https_only.en: Checks that a QC Statement of the type id-etsi-qcs-QcPDS contains a URL that uses the https scheme.
e_qcstatem_pds_must_have_https_only.zh: 类型为 id-etsi-qcs-QcPDS 的 QC 语句中的 URL 必须使用 https 协议
e_qcstatem_pds_must_have_https_only.source: ETSI 欧洲电子签名/合格证书（QC）

e_qcstatem_qccompliance_valid.en: Checks that a QC Statement of the type id-etsi-qcs-QcCompliance has the correct form
e_qcstatem_qccompliance_valid.zh: 类型为 id-etsi-qcs-QcCompliance 的 QC 语句格式必须正确
e_qcstatem_qccompliance_valid.source: ETSI 欧洲电子签名/合格证书（QC）

e_qcstatem_qclimitvalue_valid.en: Checks that a QC Statement of the type id-etsi-qcs-QcLimitValue has the correct form
e_qcstatem_qclimitvalue_valid.zh: 类型为 id-etsi-qcs-QcLimitValue 的 QC 语句格式必须正确
e_qcstatem_qclimitvalue_valid.source: ETSI 欧洲电子签名/合格证书（QC）

e_qcstatem_qcpds_valid.en: Checks that a QC Statement of the type id-etsi-qcs-QcPDS has the correct form
e_qcstatem_qcpds_valid.zh: 类型为 id-etsi-qcs-QcPDS 的 QC 语句格式必须正确
e_qcstatem_qcpds_valid.source: ETSI 欧洲电子签名/合格证书（QC）

e_qcstatem_qcretentionperiod_valid.en: Checks that a QC Statement of the type id-etsi-qcs-QcRetentionPeriod has the correct form
e_qcstatem_qcretentionperiod_valid.zh: 类型为 id-etsi-qcs-QcRetentionPeriod 的 QC 语句格式必须正确
e_qcstatem_qcretentionperiod_valid.source: ETSI 欧洲电子签名/合格证书（QC）

e_qcstatem_qcsscd_valid.en: Checks that a QC Statement of the type id-etsi-qcs-QcSSCD has the correct form
e_qcstatem_qcsscd_valid.zh: 类型为 id-etsi-qcs-QcSSCD 的 QC 语句格式必须正确
e_qcstatem_qcsscd_valid.source: ETSI 欧洲电子签名/合格证书（QC）

e_qcstatem_qctype_oneonly.en: Checks that a QC Statement of the type Id-etsi-qcs-QcType features exactly one of the allowed QcType OIDs
e_qcstatem_qctype_oneonly.zh: Id-etsi-qcs-QcType 类型的 QC 语句必须恰好包含一个允许的 QcType OID
e_qcstatem_qctype_oneonly.source: ETSI 欧洲电子签名/合格证书（QC）

e_qcstatem_qctype_smime.en: Checks that a QC Statement of the type Id-etsi-qcs-QcType features at least one of the types IdEtsiQcsQctEsign or IdEtsiQcsQctEseal, in case of an S/MIME certificate.
e_qcstatem_qctype_smime.zh: S/MIME 证书的 QcType 语句必须至少包含 ESign 或 ESeal 类型之一
e_qcstatem_qctype_smime.source: ETSI 欧洲电子签名/合格证书（QC）

e_qcstatem_qctype_valid.en: Checks that a QC Statement of the type Id-etsi-qcs-QcType features a non-empty list of only the allowed QcType OIDs
e_qcstatem_qctype_valid.zh: Id-etsi-qcs-QcType 类型的 QC 语句必须为非空且只含允许的 QcType OID 列表
e_qcstatem_qctype_valid.source: ETSI 欧洲电子签名/合格证书（QC）

e_qcstatem_qctype_web.en: Checks that a QC Statement of the type Id-etsi-qcs-QcType features at least the type IdEtsiQcsQctWeb
e_qcstatem_qctype_web.zh: QcType 类型的 QC 语句必须至少包含 IdEtsiQcsQctWeb 类型（网站认证）
e_qcstatem_qctype_web.source: ETSI 欧洲电子签名/合格证书（QC）

w_etsi_natural_person_key_usage_preferre.en: The key usage extension should use specific key usage settings for ETSI certificates issued to natural persons
w_etsi_natural_person_key_usage_preferre.zh: 签发给自然人的 ETSI 证书应使用特定的 keyUsage 设置
w_etsi_natural_person_key_usage_preferre.source: ETSI 欧洲电子签名/合格证书（QC）

w_qcstatem_qcpds_lang_case.en: Checks that a QC Statement of the type id-etsi-qcs-QcPDS features a language code comprised of only lower case letters
w_qcstatem_qcpds_lang_case.zh: id-etsi-qcs-QcPDS 类型 QC 语句的语言代码应全为小写字母
w_qcstatem_qcpds_lang_case.source: ETSI 欧洲电子签名/合格证书（QC）
